Responsabilità:
• Sotto la supervisione generale, analizza e prevede dati finanziari ed economici per fornire informazioni per decisioni strategiche e operative
• Raccoglie, verifica e analizza le informazioni finanziarie e gli indicatori economici
• Analizza le implicazioni finanziarie degli investimenti proposti o di altre transazioni per valutare alternative contro gli obiettivi aziendali
• Valuta le tendenze dell'industria, dell'economia, della finanza e del mercato per prevedere la posizione finanziaria e competitiva a breve, medio e lungo termine dell'organizzazione

Qualifiche:
• Laurea in Contabilità, Finanza o disciplina correlata
• 3-5 anni di esperienza nella contabilità e nella finanza
• Conoscenza dell'analisi finanziaria e della pianificazione

Le diverse qualifiche o responsabilità possono essere applicate in base ai requisiti legali e/o educativi locali. Fare riferimento alla documentazione locale del lavoro, se applicabile.

Informazioni su CSL Behring
CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena.

CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi.
Per saperne di più su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Viper visita https://www.csl.com/ e CSL Plasma all'indirizzo https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Responsibilities:
• Under general supervision, analyzes and forecasts financial and economic data to provide information for strategic and operational decisions
• Collects, verifies and analyzes financial information and economic indicators
• Analyzes the financial implications of proposed investments or other transactions to evaluate alternatives against business objectives
• Evaluates industry, economic, financial and market trends to forecast the organization's short, medium and long-term financial and competitive position

Qualifications:
• Bachelor degree in Accounting, Finance or related discipline
• 3-5 years' experience in accounting and finance
• Knowledge of financial analytics and planning
• German is a MUST HAVE

Different qualifications or responsibilities may apply based on local legal and/or educational requirements. Refer to local job documentation where applicable.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits

You Belong at CSL

By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ambiente di lavoro:

* Si tratta di una posizione ibrida basata in loco in una delle posizioni pubblicate con un minimo di 3 giorni settimanali in loco. Non sono previsti interventi di trasferimento e mobilità.

Principali responsabilità:

• Garantire una pianificazione e una gestione di approvvigionamenti clinici efficienti e convenienti per studi a bassa e media complessità

• Esegui la pianificazione e la previsione dei requisiti del volume di droga

• Raccolta e analisi dei campioni

• Garantisce una corretta archiviazione, trasporto e archiviazione

• Assiste alla selezione e alla gestione di fornitori di servizi esterni nel rispetto della strategia di outsourcing per garantire servizi efficienti e di alta qualità

• Leverages tecnologia di risposta interattiva (IRT) sistema per supportare le attività di gestione dell'offerta clinica

• Partner con R&D e altre funzioni per garantire un utilizzo ottimale dei sistemi e dei processi per supportare la supply chain clinica

• Supporta continui miglioramenti nella fornitura di farmaci clinici e rivede le SOP per garantire la conformità continua e la conduzione efficiente delle attività di fornitura di prova clinica

Qualifiche minime:

• Laurea in Scienze della vita, Ingegneria, Logistica o equivalente esperienza

• 5+ anni di esperienza nella gestione dell'offerta clinica con l'industria farmaceutica

• Conoscenza dimostrata delle normative ICH-GCP e della condotta degli studi clinici

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Process Development Lead is a key leadership role within Technical Operations, responsible for leading global process development teams and driving the development, optimization, and implementation of robust and scalable manufacturing processes for plasma-derived biotherapeutics.
This role combines strong people leadership, technical expertise, and strategic execution to deliver early- to late-stage development programs, lifecycle management activities, and innovation initiatives aligned with CSL’s product portfolio and Quality by Design (QbD) principles.

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities

• Accountable for the development and execution of short- to mid-term strategies for drug substance process development, including new product introduction and lifecycle management activities

• Provide technical and project leadership for process development activities from pre-clinical stage through product launch across the plasma-derived portfolio

• Lead process development for major manufacturing changes to unit operations, ensuring robust, scalable, and compliant processes

• Drive the assessment, selection, and implementation of innovative technologies to improve process performance, scalability, and product quality

• Promote and embed a Quality by Design (QbD) development approach, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations and internal standards

• Act as a change agent to advance new ways of working, including adoption of advanced manufacturing and digital approaches

• Lead Process Development execution activities and ensure alignment with project governance and portfolio priorities

• Ensure preparation, review, and approval of high-quality technical documentation and regulatory submissions

• Collaborate closely with Process Engineering, Manufacturing, and other stakeholders to ensure effective scale-up, technology transfer, and facility fit assessments

• Oversee and ensure successful transfer of processes from development to commercial manufacturing

• Engage with external partners (CROs, vendors) to optimize capabilities, resources, and project outcomes

• Lead and Manages team of employees with respect to resource planning and staff allocation to projects involving the discovery, development and manufacture of new products as well as improvements to existing products.

• Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building within the organization

• Foster a high-performance culture focused on scientific excellence, collaboration, and accountability

• Ensure execution of development activities in alignment with project timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements

• Drive continuous improvement of processes, tools, and ways of working within the function

• Ensure compliance with GMP, internal procedures, and regulatory expectations

Qualifications & Experience

• Required: Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in Life Sciences, Engineering, or related discipline

• Extensive experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical industry, or relevant academic environment

• 10+ years of relevant experience in process development, manufacturing, or related fields

• Proven experience leading teams and managing complex, cross-functional programs

• Strong scientific background in drug substance process development, particularly for biologics or plasma-derived products

• Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams in a global, matrixed environment

• Experience across early- to late-stage development, including scale-up, tech transfer, and regulatory submissions

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills

• Experience working in multicultural, international environments

descriptionByLocale.it:
Riepilogo del ruolo
Costruire ed eseguire il motore operativo del PPP di CSL ( Public-Private Partnerships ) Centro di Eccellenza — la governance, metodologie, dati, sistemi e rete interna che consentono a CSL di valutare, decidere, ed eseguire opportunità di partnership governative a velocità e come organizzazione magra. Partner del Direttore, PPP Engagements (Business Development), che guida l'impegno e l'origine del governo esterno, possiede le capacità interne, i processi e le infrastrutture che rendono tali impegni rigorosi, ripetibili e ben governati.

A. Metodologia, Strumenti e Quadri decisionali

• Migliorare e migliorare continuamente il toolkit per valutare le opportunità di partenariato governativo — modelli standardizzati di casi aziendali, criteri decisionali - garantendo analisi comparabili su mercati e opzioni di servizio. Liaise con FBP per garantire che i modelli eNPV, P&L e LRP siano sincronizzati con le ultime ipotesi e informazioni.

• Mantenere la metodologia PPP Stage Gate, i criteri di qualificazione e la governance di approvazione, compresi i diritti di decisione a ogni cancello.

• Identificare e costruire nuovi strumenti e funzionalità che aumentano l'efficienza, la resilienza e la sostenibilità del CoE.

B. Governance & Decision Forums

• Eseguire il ritmo operativo della governance PPP: preparare e orchestrare la Taskforce PPP e altri comitati (agendas, pre-reads, mazzi riutilizzabili, decisioni e monitoraggio delle azioni).

• Allineare il calendario PPP e gli input con i cicli aziendali — Piano Strategico, LRP, Market Demand & Capacity Planning — in modo che gli impegni PPP fluiscano nelle previsioni aziendali e nella pianificazione dell'offerta, in coordinamento con le Operazioni.

• Proporre l'evoluzione della governance o del formato per il collegamento con gli stakeholder interni (Taskforce, leadership, allineamento interfunzionale).

• Identificare attivamente le esigenze per l'impegno e l'organizzazione di sostegno degli stakeholder di questi impegni.

C. Pipeline & Portfolio Management

• Mantenere un oleodotto di opportunità dinamico e qualificato in stretta collaborazione con il Direttore, PPP Engagements, consentendo un approccio proattivo e mirato alla crescita.

• Definire e operare il passaggio dall'opportunità all'esecuzione — piano operativo, risonante, linee temporali, pietre miliari critici, KPI — con il piombo e le operazioni e rappresentanti del mercato locale.

D. Dati, Sistemi e Reporting

• Assicurare che i dati PPP vengano acquisiti e mantenuti nei sistemi aziendali (GTMS, Rapid Response, I360) e nei database fit-for-purpose in cui non esiste alcun sistema.

• Progettare ed eseguire cruscotti insieme a partner I&A per il monitoraggio delle metriche PPP, la salute delle tubazioni e le prestazioni esistenti di PPP per la leadership e la Taskforce PPP.

E. Conoscenza e intelligenza

• Costruire e curare un unico repository interno per documenti PPP, modelli, casi di business e approfondimenti per abilitazione di concetto "One Source of Truth".

• Collabora a stretto contatto con il team di Intelligenza Competitiva per mantenere l'intelligenza competitiva e di mercato (strutture di concorrenza, prezzi, tempi) e alimentarla in decisioni e metodologie.

• Eseguire un ciclo di apprendimento delle lezioni sulle opportunità vinte/perdute per affinare il quadro.

F. Rete interna, Abilitazione & Avocacy

• Mappa degli stakeholder interni ed esterni (roles, RACI, piani di impegno) ed eventi (ad esempio, congressi) che supportano lo sviluppo commerciale PPP. Stabilire un piano annuale per gli impegni esterni per il team PPP CoE in stretta collaborazione con il Direttore, PPP Engagements.

• Coltivare la rete interfunzionale — Commerciale, Strategia, Finanza, Legale/E&C, PAGA, Operazioni, Plasma/Supply Chain ecc.

• Costruire la consapevolezza interna del posizionamento del service-offering di CSL, e dotare le squadre di mercato locali con i playbook e la possibilità di coinvolgere costantemente le opportunità.

Qualifiche di posizione e requisiti di esperienza:

• Senior Professional con solida esperienza nella creazione e gestione delle operazioni commerciali.

• Forte acume Project Management con comprovata esperienza nel guidare, gestire e realizzare progetti.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Role summary
Build and run the operating engine of CSL's PPP ( Public-Private Partnerships ) Centre of Excellence — the governance, methodologies, data, systems and internal network that let CSL evaluate, decide on, and execute government partnership opportunities at speed and as a lean organisation. Partner with the Director, PPP Engagements (Business Development), who leads external government engagement and deal origination, by owning the internal capabilities, processes and infrastructure that make those engagements rigorous, repeatable and well-governed.

A. Methodology, Tools & Decision Frameworks

• Own and continuously improve the toolkit for evaluating government partnership opportunities — standardized business case templates, decision-making criteria - ensuring comparable analysis across markets and service options. Liaise with FBP to ensure that eNPV, P&L and LRP models are synchronized with latest assumptions and information.

• Maintain the PPP Stage Gate methodology, qualification criteria and approval governance, including decision rights at each gate.

• Identify and build new tools and capabilities that increase the CoE's efficiency, resilience and sustainability.

B. Governance & Decision Forums

• Run the operating rhythm of PPP governance: prepare and orchestrate the PPP Taskforce and other Committees (agendas, pre-reads, reusable decks, decisions and action tracking).

• Align the PPP calendar and inputs with enterprise cycles — Strategic Plan, LRP, Market Demand & Capacity Planning — so PPP commitments flow into company forecasts and supply planning, in coordination with Operations.

• Propose evolution of governance or format for connecting with internal stakeholders (Taskforce, leadership, cross-functional alignment).

• Pro-actively identify needs for stakeholder engagement and support organization of these engagements.

C. Pipeline & Portfolio Management

• Maintain a dynamic, qualified opportunity pipeline in close collaboration with the Director, PPP Engagements, enabling a proactive, focused approach to growth.

• Define and operationalize the handoff from opportunity to execution — operational plan, resourcing, timelines, critical milestones, KPIs — with the Engagements Lead and Operations and local market representatives.

D. Data, Systems & Reporting

• Ensure PPP data is captured and maintained in enterprise systems (GTMS, Rapid Response, I360) and in fit-for-purpose databases where no system exists.

• Design and run dashboards together with I&A partners for tracking PPP metrics, pipeline health and existing PPP deals performance for leadership and the PPP Taskforce.

E. Knowledge & Intelligence

• Build and curate a single internal repository for PPP documents, templates, business cases and insights for "One Source of Truth" concept enablement.

• Collaborate closely with the Competitive Intelligence team to maintain competitive and market intelligence (competitor deal structures, pricing, timing) and feed it into decisions and methodology.

• Run a lessons-learned loop on won/lost opportunities to sharpen the framework.

F. Internal Network, Enablement & Advocacy

• Map internal and external stakeholders (roles, RACI, engagement plans) and events (e.g., congresses) supporting PPP commercial development. Establish a yearly plan for external engagements for the PPP CoE team in close collaboration with the Director, PPP Engagements.

• Build internal awareness of CSL's PPP service-offering positioning, and equip local market teams with playbooks and enablement to engage opportunities consistently.

• Strong Project Management acumen with proven experience in leading, managing and delivering projects.

descriptionByLocale.de:

Partnerschaft mit dem Direktor, PPP Engagements (Business Development), der externes Regierungsengagement und Deal Origination leitet, indem er die internen Fähigkeiten, Prozesse und Infrastruktur besitzt, die diese Engagements rigoros, wiederholbar und gut regiert machen.

A. Methodik, Werkzeuge und Entscheidungsrahmen

• Eigenes und kontinuierliches Verbessern des Toolkits zur Bewertung von Möglichkeiten für staatliche Partnerschaften – standardisierte Business Case Vorlagen, Entscheidungskriterien – um eine vergleichbare Analyse über Märkte und Serviceoptionen hinweg zu gewährleisten. Verbindung mit FBP, um sicherzustellen, dass eNPV-, P&L- und LRP-Modelle mit den neuesten Annahmen und Informationen synchronisiert werden.

• Pflegen Sie die PPP Stage Gate-Methodik, Qualifizierungskriterien und Genehmigungs-Governance, einschließlich der Entscheidungsrechte an jedem Gate.

• Identifizieren und erstellen Sie neue Tools und Fähigkeiten, die die Effizienz, Widerstandsfähigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit des CoE erhöhen.

B. Governance- und Entscheidungsforen

• Führen Sie den Arbeitsrhythmus der PPP-Governance durch: Bereiten Sie die PPP Taskforce und andere Ausschüsse vor und orchestrieren Sie sie (Agenden, Pre-Reads, wiederverwendbare Decks, Entscheidungen und Aktionsverfolgung).

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Résumé des rôles
Bâtir et exploiter le moteur d'exploitation du centre d'excellence PPP de CSL (Public-Private Partnerships ) – la gouvernance, les méthodologies, les données, les systèmes et le réseau interne qui permettent à CSL d'évaluer, de décider et d'exécuter les opportunités de partenariat gouvernemental à la vitesse et en tant qu'organisation maigre. Partenariat avec le directeur, Engagement en matière de PPP (Développement des entreprises), qui dirige l'engagement externe du gouvernement et l'origine des transactions, en possédant les capacités, les processus et l'infrastructure internes qui rendent ces engagements rigoureux, répétables et bien gérés.

A. Méthodologie, outils et cadres de décision

• Améliorer en permanence la trousse d'évaluation des possibilités de partenariat du gouvernement - modèles d'analyse de rentabilisation normalisés, critères décisionnels - en assurant une analyse comparable entre les marchés et les options de service. Assurer la liaison avec FBP pour s'assurer que les modèles eNPV, P&L et LRP sont synchronisés avec les dernières hypothèses et informations.

• Maintenir la méthodologie de l'étape PPP, les critères de qualification et la gouvernance de l'approbation, y compris les droits de décision à chaque étape.

• Identifier et développer de nouveaux outils et capacités qui augmentent l'efficacité, la résilience et la durabilité du Conseil de l'Europe.

B. Forums sur la gouvernance et les décisions

• Diriger le rythme opérationnel de la gouvernance PPP : préparer et orchestrer le groupe de travail PPP et d'autres comités (agendas, pré-lectures, jeux réutilisables, décisions et suivi d'action).

• Alignez le calendrier des PPP et les intrants sur les cycles d'entreprise — Plan stratégique, PRL, Demande du marché et planification des capacités — de sorte que les engagements en matière de PPP se répercutent sur les prévisions des entreprises et la planification de l'offre, en coordination avec les Opérations.

• Proposer l'évolution de la gouvernance ou du format de connexion avec les intervenants internes (taskforce, leadership, alignement interfonctionnel).

• Déterminer de façon proactive les besoins d'engagement des intervenants et appuyer l'organisation de ces engagements.

C. Gestion des pipelines et du portefeuille

• Maintenir un portefeuille d'opportunités dynamiques et qualifiées en étroite collaboration avec le directeur, Engagement en matière de PPP, permettant une approche proactive et ciblée de la croissance.

• Définir et rendre opérationnel le transfert de l'occasion à l'exécution — plan opérationnel, ressourcement, échéanciers, jalons critiques, ICR — avec le responsable des engagements et des opérations et les représentants du marché local.

D. Données, systèmes et rapports

• Veiller à ce que les données relatives aux PPP soient saisies et conservées dans les systèmes d'entreprise (GTMS, Rapid Response, I360) et dans les bases de données adaptées aux besoins lorsqu'il n'existe pas de système.

• Concevoir et exécuter des tableaux de bord en collaboration avec des partenaires d'E et A pour suivre les paramètres des PPP, la santé des pipelines et les PPP existants traite des résultats pour le leadership et le Groupe de travail sur les PPP.

E. Connaissances et renseignements

• Créer et gérer un dépôt interne unique pour les documents PPP, les modèles, les analyses de rentabilisation et les idées pour l'activation du concept « Une source de vérité ».

• Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe du renseignement concurrentiel pour maintenir le renseignement concurrentiel et commercial (structures des marchés des concurrents, prix, calendrier) et l'alimenter dans les décisions et la méthodologie.

• Lancer une boucle de leçons apprises sur les possibilités gagnées/perdues pour affiner le cadre.

F. Réseau interne, habilitation et plaidoyer

• Planifier les intervenants internes et externes (rôles, RACI, plans d'engagement) et les événements (par exemple, congrès) qui appuient le développement commercial des PPP. Établir un plan annuel d'engagements externes pour l'équipe du Comité des partenariats public-privé en étroite collaboration avec le directeur, Engagements en matière de partenariats public-privé.

• Cultiver le réseau interfonctionnel — Commercial, Stratégie, Finances, Legal/E&C, PAGA, Opérations, Plasma/chaîne d'approvisionnement, etc.

• Accroître la sensibilisation interne au positionnement de l'offre de services PPP de CSL et doter les équipes locales du marché de livres de jeu et de moyens permettant d'engager les occasions de façon cohérente.

Qualifications du poste et exigences en matière d'expérience :

• Professionnel supérieur ayant une solide expérience dans la mise en place et la gestion des opérations commerciales.

• Forte gestion de projet avec une expérience éprouvée dans la direction, la gestion et la réalisation de projets.

Senior CI Specialist – Value Stream Bulk

Position Purpose
Are you passionate about driving operational excellence and transforming performance through Continuous Improvement?

As Senior CI Specialist , you will play a key role in shaping the future performance of Value Stream Bulk by advancing the CSL Operating System (COS) , driving a culture of continuous improvement, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Partnering closely with leaders and cross-functional teams, you will identify improvement opportunities, lead impactful initiatives, and translate strategic objectives into tangible business results. From shopfloor execution to performance management and digital transformation, you will help strengthen compliance, quality, safety, delivery, efficiency, and operational reliability.

As a trusted Continuous Improvement expert, you will empower teams, challenge the status quo, and deliver sustainable improvements that enhance both business performance and patient supply. Through your leadership, coaching, and hands-on approach, you will contribute to building a high-performing organization focused on excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.

Reporting Relationships

Reports to: Senior Director, Head Value Stream Bulk
Key Interfaces: Manufacturing, QA, QC, Planning, Engineering, Training, Supply Chain, Operational Service, Global Operational Excellence
Functional Role: CI and COS Subject Matter Expert for Value Stream Bulk
Direct Reports: None (functional leadership and coaching responsibilities)

Key Responsibilities

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Lead the deployment and continuous improvement of the CSL Operating System (COS) within Value Stream Bulk.

• Develop, manage, and execute the CI roadmap and portfolio, including project identification, business case development, prioritization, milestone planning, benefit tracking, and reporting.

• Identify and implement improvement opportunities to strengthen compliance, quality, efficiency, delivery performance, and process reliability.

• Lead and facilitate Kaizen events, Lean/Six Sigma initiatives, structured problem-solving workshops, and cross-functional improvement projects.

Performance Management & COS Reporting

• Drive KPI governance and performance management through COS-based reporting, dashboarding, visual management, and performance review routines.

• Conduct trend analyses and translate performance insights into prioritized improvement actions.

• Ensure transparency, standardization, and data integrity of performance reporting in alignment with CSL standards and business objectives.

• Monitor and communicate the impact of improvement initiatives through KPI improvement and benefit realization tracking.

Process Optimization & Change Leadership

• Drive process optimization, standardization, and digitalization initiatives across manufacturing and supporting functions.

• Coach leaders and employees in Lean Thinking, Operational Excellence principles, Visual Management, and structured problem solving.

• Act as a change agent to foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

• Ensure successful implementation of improvement initiatives on time, within budget, and with sustainable results.

Qualifications Education

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering, Natural Sciences, Business Administration, or a related discipline; equivalent experience in a GMP-regulated environment may be considered.

• Lean/Kaizen and Six Sigma certification preferred.

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or Quality.

• Proven track record in leading cross-functional improvement initiatives and delivering measurable business results.

• Experience in GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.

Competencies

• Strong expertise in Lean, Six Sigma, performance management, and structured problem-so

CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. descriptionByLocale.en:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Associate Director, Regulatory Project Manager? The job is in our Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattbrugg Switzerland or Maidenhead UK Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

You will lead global regulatory project planning and execution across CSL’s product portfolio, ensuring timely delivery of submissions and improvement initiatives aligned with GRA strategy. This role oversees submission coordination, and cross-functional collaboration to meet global health authority requirements and drive operational excellence.

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

Regulatory Project Leadership

• Lead end-to-end project management of regulatory initiatives and improvement projects (initiation through closure) within budget, scope, and timelines.

• Develop, execute, and monitor project plans, risk logs, communication strategies, and status reporting.

Submission Coordination

• Oversee regulatory submissions per CSL’s Global Submission Management Process.

• Lead submission team meetings, content planning, tracking in RIMS, and ensure on-time, compliant submissions.

• Liaise with global, regional, and local teams for successful execution

Continuous Improvement & Governance

• Manage improvement projects portfolio in alignment with GRA strategy and executive priorities.

• Support quarterly reporting to Portfolio Committee and implement process efficiencies.

• Contribute to governance, best practices, and standardization across regulatory operations.

Management & Collaboration

• May be required to manage Regulatory Project Managers

• Leads cross-functionally with Regulatory, Clinical, Manufacturing, POE (GPM) and external partners.

• Mentor junior project managers and support training on submission processes and tools.

• Liaise with Regulatory Policy to ensure awareness and incorporation of policy changes into Regulatory strategy, planning, and execution

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or Business required; advanced degree (MSc, PhD, MBA) and PMP certification preferred.

• 7+ years of experience in pharma/biotech industry with a focus on biologics and regulatory affairs.

• 7+ years’ experience managing global, cross-functional projects in a matrix environment.

• Strong knowledge of global regulatory submission processes, drug development lifecycle, and project governance.

• Demonstrated success in delivering complex projects on time and within scope.

The expected base salary range for this position at hiring is $170,000-210,000. Please note this salary range reflects the minimum and maximum base pay that CSL expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting in MA. Individual base salary for a successful candidate is determined by qualifications, skill level, experience, competencies and other relevant factors. In addition to base salary, total compensation for this role may also include incentive compensation and equity.

#LI-HYBRID

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

Vous dirigerez la planification et l'exécution de projets de réglementation à l'échelle mondiale dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits de CSL, assurant la livraison en temps opportun des soumissions et des initiatives d'amélioration alignées sur la stratégie de GRA. Ce rôle supervise la coordination des présentations et la collaboration interfonctionnelle pour répondre aux exigences des autorités sanitaires mondiales et stimuler l'excellence opérationnelle.

Principales responsabilités et responsabilités :

Leadership du projet de réglementation

• Diriger la gestion de bout en bout des initiatives réglementaires et des projets d'amélioration (amorce par la clôture) dans les limites du budget, de la portée et des délais.

• Élaborer, exécuter et surveiller les plans de projet, les registres des risques, les stratégies de communication et les rapports de situation.

Coordination des demandes

• Superviser les présentations réglementaires selon le processus global de gestion des présentations.

• Réunions de l'équipe responsable des présentations, planification du contenu, suivi dans le SGIR, et s'assurer que les présentations sont conformes à temps.

• Assurer la liaison avec les équipes mondiales, régionales et locales pour une exécution réussie

Amélioration continue et gouvernance

• Gérer le portefeuille de projets d'amélioration conformément à la stratégie de GRA et aux priorités de l'exécutif.

• Appuyer la présentation de rapports trimestriels au comité du Portefeuille et mettre en oeuvre des processus efficaces.

• Contribuer à la gouvernance, aux pratiques exemplaires et à la normalisation dans toutes les opérations réglementaires.

Gestion et collaboration

• Peut-être nécessaire pour gérer les gestionnaires de projets réglementaires

• Le plomb est interfonctionnel avec les partenaires réglementaires, cliniques, manufacturiers, POE (GPM) et externes.

• Mentor, gestionnaire de projet junior et soutien de la formation sur les processus et les outils de présentation.

• Assurer la liaison avec la politique réglementaire pour assurer la sensibilisation et l'intégration des changements de politique dans la stratégie, la planification et l'exécution de la réglementation

Qualifications et expérience

• Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie ou en affaires requis; diplôme avancé (MSc, doctorat, MBA) et la certification PMP préféré.

• 7+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique et biotechnologique avec un accent sur les produits biologiques et les affaires réglementaires.

• 7+ ans d'expérience en gestion de projets mondiaux et interfonctionnels dans un environnement matriciel.

• Connaissance approfondie des processus de présentation de la réglementation mondiale, du cycle de développement des médicaments et de la gouvernance des projets.

• Le succès démontré dans la réalisation de projets complexes à temps et dans le respect de la portée.

L'échelle salariale de base prévue pour ce poste est de 170 000 $ à 210 000 $. Veuillez noter que cette échelle salariale reflète la rémunération de base minimale et maximale que la LSC s'attend à payer pour ce poste au moment de l'affectation en MA. Le salaire de base individuel d'un candidat reçu est déterminé par les qualifications, le niveau de compétence, l'expérience, les compétences et d'autres facteurs pertinents. En plus du salaire de base, la rémunération totale pour ce rôle peut également inclure la rémunération incitative et l'équité.

#LI-HYBRID

À propos de CSL Behring
CSL Behring est un chef de file mondial en biothérapeutique animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Concentré sur les besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et livrons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant dans des conditions dans les domaines immunologiques, hématologiques, cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et transplantés. Nous utilisons trois plateformes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement plasmatique, la technologie des protéines recombinantes et la thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue et affiner continuellement les façons dont les produits peuvent répondre aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits et aider les patients à mener une vie entière.

Under the direction of senior leadership, the Executive Assistant provides comprehensive administrative and organizational support to assigned leadership within Research & Development. This role includes managing complex calendars, coordinating meetings and events, and handling domestic and international travel arrangements. The Executive Assistant ensures meeting readiness, manages individual expense reporting, and supports special projects as needed. The position requires interaction with a diverse group of internal stakeholders across all levels and locations, as well as external partners and visitors, while maintaining professionalism and confidentiality at all times.

Responsibilities

1. Administrative Support

• Provide diversified administrative support to assigned senior leaders and their teams, including word processing, filing, mailings, and document management.

• Organize and maintain confidential and time-sensitive materials and files.

Calendar & Meeting Management

• Manage calendars and schedule appointments for assigned executives and leadership team members.

• Ensure meeting materials are prepared and assist in tracking priorities and deliverables.

2. Event & Project Coordination

• Plan and manage special projects and events for assigned leadersa, including global meetings and project-related sessions.
• Arrange facilities, catering, invitations, and travel for internal and external participants.

• Monitor and control event budgets.

• Prepare visual presentations and meeting materials as needed.

3. Travel & Expense Coordination

• Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements and compile itineraries.

• Prepare documents for travel-related meetings and process expense reports accurately and promptly.

• Reconcile corporate credit card accounts for assigned leaders

4. Budget & Compliance

• Monitor standard expenditures to ensure activities remain within established budgets.

• Manage implementation of legal contracts and agreements, ensuring proper signatures and maintaining organized files.

5. Onboarding & Collaboration

• Support onboarding of new hires of assigned leaders and collaborate with other administrative professionals to ensure a consistent experience.

• Serve as a liaison with internal and external stakeholders globally, representing the department professionally and maintaining confidentiality

6. Other Duties

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Education Requirements
High School Diploma or equivalent vocational or technical training.
Bachelor’s degree or Technical College degree a plus.

Experience Requirements
3-5+ years' administrative support experience preferably in within pharmaceutical industry

This role requires working in at our site 3 days per week at our office location

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

Posizione provvisoria, 1 anno | Schlieren, Svizzera

Stiamo cercando uno scienziato pratico per unire il nostro team di Farmacologia Meccanica all'interno della Ricerca Traduttiva a Schlieren. Questa posizione temporanea di un anno si concentrerà sullo sviluppo e l'applicazione di modelli in vitro umano, saggi funzionali e approcci di editing genico per supportare i programmi di ricerca cardiovascolare e renale.

Informazioni sul ruolo

• Sviluppare e applicare modelli in vitro umani e flussi di lavoro di saggi funzionali per supportare programmi di ricerca traduttiva.

• Generare dati sperimentali di alta qualità per caratterizzare il modo di azione di nuovi candidati terapeutici in indicazioni cardiovascolari e renali.

• Indipendentemente eseguire la cultura delle cellule umane, la trasfezione, la modifica dei geni e i flussi di lavoro di analisi con forte attenzione al rigore scientifico, la riproducibilità e la qualità dei dati.

• Contribuisci alla progettazione, ottimizzazione e miglioramento continuo degli approcci sperimentali e delle prestazioni del test.

• Analizzare, interpretare e presentare chiaramente risultati sperimentali a team di progetto e stakeholder.

• Mantenere la documentazione accurata del lavoro sperimentale e sostenere l'attuazione delle migliori pratiche di laboratorio e standard di qualità.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle procedure di sicurezza di laboratorio e contribuire a un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, ben organizzato e collaborativo.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli scienziati attraverso progetti e funzioni, contribuendo a un ambiente di ricerca altamente interattivo e orientato al team.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale in biologia cellulare, scienze della vita, o una disciplina scientifica correlata, o equivalente esperienza di laboratorio rilevante; l'esperienza industriale è un vantaggio.

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza pratica di laboratorio nella biologia cellulare, tra cui una forte esperienza nella cultura delle cellule umane, come gli HUVEC e i metodi di trasfezione.

• Esperienza pratica con approcci di editing gene basati su CRISPR.

• Proficienza nelle tecniche di biologia molecolare, tra cui RT-qPCR, immunoassays e Western blotting.

• L'esperienza con le tecniche basate sull'imaging è un vantaggio.

• Esperienza nella risoluzione dei problemi esperimenti, nella gestione di apparecchiature di laboratorio e nell'ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro per migliorare la robustezza e le prestazioni del test.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e prendere la proprietà di esperimenti dal design dello studio attraverso l'esecuzione, l'analisi e la presentazione dei risultati.

• Forte capacità organizzative, attenzione ai dettagli e impegno nella documentazione sperimentale di alta qualità.

• Competenza in inglese scritto e parlato.

• Mindset collaborativo, flessibilità e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team e con diversi stakeholder di progetto.

CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi.

Scientist (m/f/x) – Cell Biology and Gene Editing
Temporary position, 1 year | Schlieren, Switzerland

We are looking for a hands-on Scientist to join our Mechanistic Pharmacology team within Translational Research in Schlieren. This temporary one-year position will focus on developing and applying human in vitro models, functional assays, and gene editing approaches to support cardiovascular and renal research programs.

About the Role

• Develop and apply human in vitro models and functional assay workflows to support translational research programs.

• Generate high-quality experimental data to characterize the mode of action of novel therapeutic candidates in cardiovascular and renal indications.

• Independently perform human cell culture, transfection, gene editing, and assay workflows with strong attention to scientific rigor, reproducibility, and data quality.

• Contribute to the design, optimization, and continuous improvement of experimental approaches and assay performance.

• Analyze, interpret, and clearly present experimental results to project teams and stakeholders.

• Maintain accurate documentation of experimental work and support implementation of laboratory best practices and quality standards.

• Ensure compliance with laboratory safety procedures and contribute to a safe, well-organized, and collaborative working environment.

• Work closely with scientists across projects and functions, contributing to a highly interactive and team-oriented research setting.

Your Profile

• Master’s degree in Cell Biology, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant laboratory experience; industry experience is an advantage.

• At least 3 years of practical laboratory experience in cell biology, including strong expertise in human cell culture, such as HUVECs, and transfection methods.

• Hands-on experience with CRISPR-based gene editing approaches.

• Proficiency in molecular biology techniques, including RT-qPCR, immunoassays and Western blotting.

• Experience with imaging-based techniques is an advantage.

• Experience in troubleshooting experiments, handling laboratory equipment, and optimizing workflows to improve assay robustness and performance.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of experiments from study design through execution, analysis, and presentation of results.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to high-quality experimental documentation.

• Proficiency in written and spoken English.

• Collaborative mindset, flexibility, and ability to work effectively across teams and with different project stakeholders.

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

• Führen Sie unabhängig menschliche Zellkultur, Transfektion, Genbearbeitung und Assay-Workflows mit großer Aufmerksamkeit auf wissenschaftliche Strenge, Reproduzierbarkeit und Datenqualität durch.

Ihr Profil

• Master-Abschluss in Zellbiologie, Biowissenschaften oder einer verwandten wissenschaftlichen Disziplin oder gleichwertige relevante Laborerfahrung; Industrieerfahrung ist ein Vorteil.

• Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Laborerfahrung in der Zellbiologie, einschließlich starker Expertise in der menschlichen Zellkultur, wie HUVECs, und Transfektionsmethoden.

• Praxiserfahrung mit CRISPR-basierten Gen-Editing-Ansätzen.

• Kenntnisse in molekularbiologischen Verfahren, einschließlich RT-qPCR, Immunoassays und Westernblotting.

• Erfahrung mit bildgebenden Verfahren ist von Vorteil.

• Erfahrung in der Fehlerbehebung von Experimenten, dem Umgang mit Laborgeräten und der Optimierung von Workflows zur Verbesserung der Robustheit und Leistung von Tests.

• Kenntnisse in schriftlichem und gesprochenem Englisch.

• Kollaborative Denkweise, Flexibilität und Fähigkeit, effektiv in Teams und mit verschiedenen Projektbeteiligten zu arbeiten.

Über CSL Behring
CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biotherapeutika, angetrieben von unserem Versprechen, Leben zu retten. Konzentriert auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten durch den Einsatz der neuesten Technologien, entdecken, entwickeln und liefern wir innovative Therapien für Menschen mit Erkrankungen in den Bereichen Immunologie, Hämatologie, Herz-Kreislauf und Stoffwechsel, Atmung und Transplantation. Wir nutzen drei strategische wissenschaftliche Plattformen der Plasmafraktionierung, rekombinante Proteintechnologie und Zell- und Gentherapie, um kontinuierliche Innovationen zu unterstützen und kontinuierlich Wege zu verfeinern, wie Produkte ungedeckte medizinische Bedürfnisse erfüllen und Patienten helfen können, ein volles Leben zu führen.

Nous cherchons un scientifique pratique pour rejoindre notre équipe de pharmacologie mécaniste au sein de la recherche translationnelle à Schlieren. Ce poste temporaire d'un an sera axé sur l'élaboration et l'application de modèles in vitro humains, d'essais fonctionnels et d'approches d'édition de gènes pour appuyer les programmes de recherche cardiovasculaire et rénale.

À propos du rôle

• Élaborer et appliquer des modèles humains in vitro et des processus d'essai fonctionnels pour appuyer les programmes de recherche translationnelle.

• Générer des données expérimentales de haute qualité pour caractériser le mode d'action des nouveaux candidats thérapeutiques dans les indications cardiovasculaires et rénales.

• Exécuter indépendamment la culture cellulaire humaine, la transfection, l'édition de gènes et les processus d'essai avec une grande attention à la rigueur scientifique, la reproductibilité et la qualité des données.

• Contribuer à la conception, à l'optimisation et à l'amélioration continue des approches expérimentales et de la performance des essais.

• Analyser, interpréter et présenter clairement les résultats expérimentaux aux équipes de projet et aux intervenants.

• Maintenir une documentation exacte des travaux expérimentaux et appuyer la mise en oeuvre des meilleures pratiques de laboratoire et des normes de qualité.

• Assurer la conformité aux procédures de sécurité en laboratoire et contribuer à un milieu de travail sécuritaire, bien organisé et collaboratif.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les scientifiques dans l'ensemble des projets et des fonctions, contribuant ainsi à un cadre de recherche hautement interactif et axé sur l'équipe.

Votre profil

• Maîtrise en biologie cellulaire, sciences de la vie ou discipline scientifique connexe, ou expérience de laboratoire pertinente équivalente; l'expérience de l'industrie est un avantage.

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience pratique en biologie cellulaire, y compris une solide expertise en culture cellulaire humaine, comme les HUVEC, et les méthodes de transfection.

• Expérience pratique des approches d'édition de gènes fondées sur le CRISPR.

• Compétence en techniques de biologie moléculaire, y compris RT-qPCR, immunoessais et blotting Western.

• L'expérience des techniques d'imagerie est un avantage.

• Expérience dans le dépannage des expériences, la manipulation des équipements de laboratoire et l'optimisation des workflows pour améliorer la robustesse et la performance des tests.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et de prendre en charge les expériences depuis la conception des études jusqu'à l'exécution, l'analyse et la présentation des résultats.

• Fortes compétences organisationnelles, attention aux détails et engagement envers une documentation expérimentale de haute qualité.

• Compétence en anglais écrit et parlé.

• L'esprit de collaboration, la souplesse et la capacité de travailler efficacement entre les équipes et avec les différents intervenants du projet.

CSL Behring est un chef de file mondial en biothérapeutique animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. The Opportunity:
The Product Strategy Lead is the end‑to‑end owner of integrated Product Strategy for an assigned portfolio of products, accountable for translating commercial ambition and R&D strategy into clear, executable manufacturing and operations strategies across the full product lifecycle.

This role serves as the primary strategic integrator across Manufacturing and Technical Operations, Commercial, R&D, Business Development, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance, and Network Strategy. The Product Strategy Lead ensures product‑level decisions regarding investment, capacity, capability, and lifecycle trade‑offs are coherent, value‑driven, and aligned to enterprise priorities, enabling safe, reliable supply of CSL products to patients.

Acting as the product’s representative in senior governance forums, the Product Strategy Lead shapes and anchors product‑level strategic decisions, ensuring leadership has a clear, fact‑based view of options, risks, trade‑offs, and value implications across time horizons.

The Role:
Product Strategy Ownership and Integration

• Owns the single, integrated Product Strategy for assigned products, ensuring end‑to‑end alignment across Commercial, R&D, BD, and Operations.

• Acts as the product‑level strategy decision owner within Operations, accountable for framing options, recommending trade‑offs, and anchoring decisions adopted through governance.

• Ensures product strategies balance cost, risk, speed, supply resilience, and long‑term enterprise value.

Portfolio & Lifecycle Strategy

• Leads end‑to‑end product lifecycle strategy, including development, launch strategy, growth, optimization, and end‑of‑life decisions.

• Actively manages portfolio trade‑offs across assigned products, including prioritization, sequencing of investments, and capacity or capability allocation.

• Ensures lifecycle decisions are grounded in both current performance and future portfolio needs.

Financial & Investment Framing

• Owns the financial and value framing of product‑level strategy decisions, including investment rationale, scenario analysis, and long‑term value impact.

• Provides product inputs into Long‑Range Planning (LRP), ensuring commercial assumptions, manufacturing strategy, and capacity plans are tightly aligned.

• Partners with Finance to ensure leadership decisions are supported by clear economic logic and value realization expectations.

Cross Functional Alignment and Orchestration

• Leads and orchestrates cross‑functional stakeholders across TechOps, Network Strategy, R&D, Commercial, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Procurement, and BD.

• Drives alignment and resolves conflicts across competing priorities, operating effectively without direct authority.

• Ensures execution ownership and decision rights are clear following governance outcomes.

Executive Governance & Communication

• Develops and presents decision‑ready recommendations to senior governance bodies including GLT members, NRB, ORB, IBP, and other executive forums.

• Distills complex technical, regulatory, manufacturing, and financial information into clear executive narratives.

• Acts as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders on product‑level strategy matters.

Product Lifecycle and Portfolio Strategy

• Leads end‑to‑end product lifecycle management, including development, launch, growth, optimization, and end‑of‑life decisions.

• Ensures portfolio strategy balances near‑term performance with long‑term enterprise value creation.

Owns product‑level inputs into Long‑Range Planning (LRP)

• Converts commercial forecasts, Business Development intent, and lifecycle scenarios into clear demand, volume, timing, and risk assumptions

• Ensures assumptions are internally consistent and defensible across functions

• Acts as the single source of truth for product demand logic in planning cycles

• Integrates LRP and capacity decisions into product lifecycle strategy

• Shapes capacity and network strate
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Gelegenheit:
Der Product Strategy Lead ist der End-to-End-Eigentümer der integrierten Produktstrategie für ein zugewiesenes Produktportfolio, das dafür verantwortlich ist, kommerzielle Ambitionen und F & E-Strategie in klare, ausführbare Fertigungs- und Betriebsstrategien über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus zu übersetzen.

Diese Rolle dient als primärer strategischer Integrator in den Bereichen Fertigung und technische Operationen, Kommerzielle Entwicklung, F & E, Geschäftsentwicklung, Qualität, Regulierung, Supply Chain, Finanzen und Netzwerkstrategie. Der Product Strategy Lead stellt sicher, dass Entscheidungen auf Produktebene in Bezug auf Investitionen, Kapazität, Kapazität und Lebenszyklus-Kompromisse kohärent, wertorientiert und an den Unternehmensprioritäten ausgerichtet sind, was eine sichere und zuverlässige Versorgung der Patienten mit CSL-Produkten ermöglicht.

Als Vertreter des Produkts in Senior-Governance-Foren gestaltet und verankert der Product Strategy Lead strategische Entscheidungen auf Produktebene und stellt sicher, dass die Führung eine klare, faktenbasierte Sicht auf Optionen, Risiken, Kompromisse und Wertimplikationen über Zeithorizonte hinweg hat.

Die Rolle:
Product Strategy Ownership und Integration

• Eigentümer der einzigen, integrierten Produktstrategie für zugewiesene Produkte, die eine End-to-End-Anpassung in den Bereichen Commercial, R&D, BD und Operations gewährleistet.

• Agiert als Eigentümer der Strategieentscheidung auf Produktebene innerhalb von Operations, verantwortlich für die Gestaltung von Optionen, die Empfehlung von Kompromissen und die Verankerung von Entscheidungen, die durch Governance getroffen werden.

• Sicherstellt, dass Produktstrategien Kosten, Risiko, Geschwindigkeit, Versorgungsresistenz und langfristigen Unternehmenswert ausgleichen.

Portfolio & Lifecycle Strategie

• Leitet eine End-to-End-Produktlebenszyklusstrategie, einschließlich Entwicklung, Launch-Strategie, Wachstum, Optimierung und End-of-Life-Entscheidungen.

• Verwaltet aktiv Portfolio-Trade-offs über zugewiesene Produkte hinweg, einschließlich Priorisierung, Sequenzierung von Investitionen und Kapazitäts- oder Kapazitätszuweisung.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Lifecycle-Entscheidungen sowohl auf der aktuellen Performance als auch auf den zukünftigen Portfolioanforderungen basieren.

Financial & Investment Framing

• Besitzt die Finanz- und Wertgestaltung von Strategieentscheidungen auf Produktebene, einschließlich Anlagegrundsätzen, Szenarioanalysen und langfristigen Wertwirkungen.

Cross Functional Alignment und Orchestrierung

• Leitet und orchestriert funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder in den Bereichen TechOps, Network Strategy, R&D, Commercial, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Procurement und BD.

Executive Governance und Kommunikation

Product Lifecycle und Portfoliostrategie

Eigene Inputs auf Produktebene in Long-Range Planning (LRP)

La possibilité :
Le responsable de la stratégie des produits est le propriétaire de bout en bout de la stratégie intégrée des produits pour un portefeuille de produits assigné, responsable de la traduction de l'ambition commerciale et de la stratégie de R-D en stratégies de fabrication et d'exploitation claires et exécutables tout au long du cycle de vie des produits.

Ce rôle est le principal intégrateur stratégique dans les secteurs de la fabrication et des opérations techniques, du commerce, de la R-D, du développement des entreprises, de la qualité, de la réglementation, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des finances et de la stratégie de réseau. Le responsable de la stratégie des produits veille à ce que les décisions relatives à l'investissement, à la capacité, à la capacité et au cycle de vie soient cohérentes, axées sur la valeur et alignées sur les priorités de l'entreprise, ce qui permet un approvisionnement sûr et fiable des patients en produits LSC.

En tant que représentant du produit dans les forums de gouvernance de haut niveau, la Stratégie produit Le chef de file façonne et ancre les décisions stratégiques au niveau du produit, en s'assurant que le leadership a une vision claire et factuelle des options, des risques, des compromis et des répercussions sur la valeur à travers les horizons temporels.

Le rôle :
Stratégie de produit Propriété et intégration

• Posséder la stratégie unique et intégrée des produits attribués, en assurant l'harmonisation de bout en bout entre les activités commerciales, de R-D, de BD et d'exploitation.

• Agit en tant que propriétaire de décision au niveau des produits au sein des Opérations, responsable de l'élaboration des options, de la recommandation des compromis et de l'ancrage des décisions adoptées par la gouvernance.

• S'assure que les stratégies de produits équilibrent les coûts, les risques, la vitesse, la résilience de l'offre et la valeur à long terme de l'entreprise.

Stratégie du Portefeuille et du cycle de vie

• Dirige la stratégie du cycle de vie des produits de bout en bout, y compris le développement, la stratégie de lancement, la croissance, l'optimisation et les décisions de fin de vie.

• Gérer activement les arbitrages de portefeuille entre les produits attribués, y compris la hiérarchisation, le séquençage des investissements et l'attribution des capacités.

• S'assure que les décisions relatives au cycle de vie sont fondées à la fois sur la performance actuelle et sur les besoins futurs du portefeuille.

Cadre financier et d'investissement

• Possède l'encadrement financier et de valeur des décisions stratégiques au niveau des produits, y compris la justification de l'investissement, l'analyse de scénarios et l'impact à long terme sur la valeur.

• Fournit des intrants de produits dans la planification à long terme (PDR), en veillant à ce que les hypothèses commerciales, la stratégie de fabrication et les plans de capacité soient étroitement alignés.

• Les partenaires du ministère des Finances s'assurent que les décisions en matière de leadership sont étayées par une logique économique claire et des attentes en matière de valorisation.

Alignement et orchestre fonctionnels croisés

• Dirige et orchestre les intervenants interfonctionnels dans l'ensemble de TechOps, Stratégie de réseau, R-D, Commercial, Chaîne d'approvisionnement, Qualité, Réglementation, Finances, Approvisionnement et BD.

• Conduit l'alignement et règle les conflits entre les priorités concurrentes, fonctionnant efficacement sans autorité directe.

• Veiller à ce que les droits de propriété et de décision soient clairs à la suite des résultats de la gouvernance.

Gouvernance exécutive et communication

• Élaborer et présenter des recommandations prêtes à prendre des décisions à l'intention des organismes supérieurs de gouvernance, y compris les membres du GLT, le CRN, le BPR, le BPI et d'autres forums de la direction.

• Distiller des informations techniques, réglementaires, manufacturières et financières complexes dans des récits clairs de l'exécutif.

• Agir à titre de conseiller stratégique de confiance auprès des cadres supérieurs sur les questions de stratégie au niveau des produits.

Cycle de vie des produits et stratégie de portefeuille

• Diriger la gestion du cycle de vie des produits de bout en bout, y compris les décisions de développement, de lancement, de croissance, d'optimisation et de fin de vie.

• Assurer des équilibres stratégiques à court terme avec la création de valeur à long terme de l'entreprise.

Possède des intrants de niveau produit dans la planification à long terme (PLT)

• Convertit les prévisions commerciales, l'intention de développement des entreprises et les scénarios du cycle de vie en une demande claire, en volume, en calendrier et en hypothèses de risque

• S'assurer que les hypothèses sont cohérentes à l'interne et défendables entre les fonctions

• Agir comme source unique de vérité pour la logique de la demande de produit dans les cycles de planification

• Intégre les décisions en matière de LRP et de capacité dans la stratégie du cycle de vie des produits

• Capacité des formes et stratégie de réseau

Competenze

descriptionByLocale.en:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

As Principal Biostatistician you will provide high level expertise in the specialist area of Research Biostatistics. You will support research activities in alignment with the respective Therapeutic Area (TA) Research Strategies. In collaboration with Research teams contribute statistical input towards experimental designs, statistical analyses, interpretation and reporting of research studies, to ensure efficient use of resources as well as robust conclusions and deliveries following regulatory requirements and guidelines. The position plays a key role in executing research strategies, fostering internal and external partnerships, and ensuring delivery of impactful preclinical and translational science packages that support clinical development and business objectives.

Main Responsibilities:

Functional Responsibilities​

• Execute Biostatistics strategies aligned with global therapeutic area (TA) and platform priorities, closely collaborating with across Global Research with key connections with Bioinformatics & AI, Translational Research, Research Therapeutic area leads and research project teams​

• Maintain relevant state-of-the-art knowledge and capabilities through literature review and participation in scientific meetings​

• Oversee statistical design and analysis routines in experiments that translate development strategies into plans to support product development objectives, including process control and validation strategies.​

• Utilise expertise to provide statistical input towards experimental designs, statistical analyses, interpretation and reporting of research studies ​

• Provide statistical advice for contacts with regulatory agencies for pre-clinical R&D topics, e.g., in animal ethics applications​

• Contribute statistical input for regulatory filings for product approvals, for on-market support, and for scientific publications ​

• Coordinate with other data analysis/computational experts (Data Managers, Bioinformaticians, Imaging & AI Analysts, PK/PD/Pharmacometricians, etc.) both in house and externally, to ensure that CSL R&D is current and compliant in statistical methods​

Scientific Innovation & Communication​

• Provide scientific input across R&D programs, including drug discovery, in vitro pharmacology, biomarker development, and OMICS studies..​

• Execute Biostatistical pipelines to enable early decision making across research, drive efficiency and generation of high quality data ​

• Compile scientific reports, regulatory documents, and peer-reviewed publications.​

• Present research findings at internal and external meetings and maintain state-of-the-art knowledge through literature and congress participation.​

External Collaboration & Representation​

• Establish and maintain collaborations with academic institutions, biotech companies, CROs, and other external partners to support execution of the Research Project Portfolio.

• Support patent filings and legal contract negotiations in collaboration with CSL’s legal and IP departments.​

• Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in Statistics, Biostatistics, or equivalent experience​

• Excellent communication, analytical, and interpersonal skills..​

descriptionByLocale.en:
Global Product Leader
Some roles exist to manage processes. This one exists to make consequential decisions about medicines that matter to patients with serious diseases — and to ensure those decisions are made well, at pace, and with the full weight of evidence behind them.
CSL Behring is seeking a Global Product Leader (GPL) to take end-to-end ownership of a late-stage development asset, from late research transition through development, commercialization, and lifecycle management. The accountability is real: for strategy, for delivery, and for the value the asset creates across its lifetime.

The Role
As GPL, you will sit on the Therapeutic Area Leadership Team and represent the asset at CSL's most senior governance forums. You will lead a global, cross-functional Product Strategy Team — bringing together clinical, regulatory, commercial, manufacturing, and scientific expertise into a coherent, executable plan. You will own the asset strategy, drive it through governance with clear, well-framed recommendations, and ensure the organization moves decisively when decisions are needed.
The scope is broad. You will integrate competitive intelligence, payer dynamics, patient insights, and evolving clinical data into strategic trade-offs. You will lead lifecycle value creation — label expansions, new indications, geographic reach. You will represent CSL externally, including in due diligence and partnership contexts. Your thinking will be tested by people who know the science, the market, and the economics — and it needs to hold up.
Leadership here means influence rather than line authority: building alignment across functions and sustaining it through organizational complexity, competing priorities, and the inevitable turbulence of long development programs.

What You'll Be Responsible For
You will own the Product Strategy Plan and keep it current as data and conditions evolve — balancing honest advocacy for the asset with the objectivity to adjust when the evidence calls for it. You will prepare governance bodies to make good decisions by giving them well-structured options, clear trade-offs, and a recommendation you're willing to defend. You will anticipate risks and surface them early, rather than letting surprises reach the wrong moment.
You will shape a team culture where problems are raised before they escalate, accountability is shared, and the work moves with both strategic clarity and execution discipline. You will contribute to building the next generation of product leaders at CSL and to the continued development of the GPL function itself.

What We're Looking For
You likely have 12 or more years in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical development, with experience that spans the value chain — from late research or early clinical stages through to commercialization or market access. You have owned an asset in a meaningful sense: responsible for its direction and outcomes, not just its coordination.
You can hold a position under pressure and revise it when the data warrant. You can read a complex situation — scientific, organizational, commercial — and turn it into a clear narrative and a plan that people will follow.
An advanced degree is required; a PhD, MD, PharmD, or MBA is preferred. Therapeutic area expertise in CSL Behring's portfolio is an advantage, though not a prerequisite for the right candidate.

Working Arrangements
Hybrid, 3 days a week onsite, plus business travel

We are currently looking for a Senior Scientist, Mechanistic Pharmacology in Translational Research (complex in vitro models cardiovascular and renal indications) to join our team in Schlieren, ZH.

Key Tasks

• Develop, optimize, and apply advanced cellular and complex in vitro models with translational relevance for cardiovascular and renal indications

• Provide scientific leadership in the selection, establishment, and use of cellular model systems to support translational project objectives.

• Design and execute functional assays to generate high-quality data for target validation, mechanistic studies, and characterization of therapeutic candidates.

• Interact with project teams, communicating data, insights, and recommendations clearly to colleagues and stakeholders.

• Support external collaborations and outsourcing activities where needed, ensuring scientific quality and alignment with project goals.

Your Profile

• Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacology, Cell Biology, or a related scientific discipline; a PhD is preferred.

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in industry or a comparable academic research environment focused on cardiovascular or kidney biology

• Strong expertise in complex cellular model systems (ipsc, co-culture, organoids and/or organ-on-a-chip) and translationally relevant in vitro assay development.

• A problem-solving mindset with the ability to define critical scientific questions and translate them into effective experimental strategies.

• Demonstrated ability to present scientific data and concepts clearly to colleagues, cross-functional teams, and management.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams and external partners.

• A proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented approach, combined with a curious and disciplined mindset

• Strong collaborative mindset, with the flexibility to work effectively across teams and with different project stakeholders.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer
CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

CSL's organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Associate Director, Medical Affairs (Immunology)? The job is in our Maidenhead, UK or Zurich, CH Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week. You will report to the Senior Director, Medical Affairs, Immunology.

You will contribute to the development of medical strategy for assigned inline products in Immunology and drive the execution of Medical Affairs plans across the post-launch product lifecycle. Working in close collaboration with cross-functional partners and engaging effectively with external thought leaders, the role helps drive medical and scientific communication, support evidence generation, advance clinical understanding, and strengthen scientific engagement in global markets (US and International). This position requires strong expertise in Medical Affairs, a solid understanding of global standards and practices, and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and affiliate teams.

Responsibilities:

• Responsible for contributing to the medical affairs strategy for assigned portfolio in alignment with overall therapeutic area objectives

• Evaluates trends and therapeutic opportunities in cooperation with research and regional commercial organizations

• Implements strategy for scientific interactions with the medical community including key opinion leaders and patient advocacy groupsSupports coordination of investigator led studies and research collaborations

• Serves as scientific consultant to marketing, commercial and research project teams, providing input into promotional and educational materials for relevant therapeutic areas

Qualifications:

• Advanced degree in science (PhD, PharmD, MD)

• Signififcant relevant pharmaceutical/ biotherapeutics industry experience

• Sound experience interacting with commercial functions within the healthcare industry

• Knowledge of Immunology

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

Dies ist eine hybride Position und ist an drei Tagen in der Woche vor Ort. Sie werden dem Senior Director, Medical Affairs, Immunology berichten. Sie werden zur Entwicklung einer medizinischen Strategie für zugewiesene Inline-Produkte in der Immunologie beitragen und die Ausführung von Medical Affairs-Plänen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus nach dem Start vorantreiben. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Partnern und einer effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit externen Vordenkern trägt die Rolle dazu bei, die medizinische und wissenschaftliche Kommunikation voranzutreiben, die Evidenzgenerierung zu unterstützen, das klinische Verständnis zu verbessern und das wissenschaftliche Engagement in globalen Märkten (USA und International) zu stärken.
