Descrizione Responsible as Senior EHS Expert – Risk Management & Technical Safety (f/m/d) They develop, implement and continuously improve a systematic, ISO‐45001-compliant EHS risk management at the Bern site. The role includes the moderation and implementation of risk analyses, risk assessments, pSIF investigations, technical safety assessments as well as the intensive EHS supervision of construction, plant and process projects. In addition, the role of the EHS specialist coordinates: inside projects and acts as a technical hub between engineering, operations, quality and EHS. This position is aimed at experienced senior EHS experts with 8–10 years of professional experience, strong technical know-how, risk management expertise and very good communication and moderation expertise. Main tasks and responsibilities Risk Management & Hazard Analysis - Moderation and implementation of risk analyses and risk assessments - (including HAZOP, JSA, Bow‐Tie, FMEA, Task-Risk-Assessments) - Establishment, maintenance and coordination of the location-wide risk register - Development of Risk Mitigation Strategies for Processes, Plants, Infrastructure and Activities - Ensuring consistent methods according to ISO 45001 and CSL Technical Standards Incident Investigation & Prevention - Head of pSIF investigations and root cause analyses (ICAM, TapRoot, RCA) - Definition and monitoring of sustainable prevention measures - Lessons Learned and Transfer to Standards, SOPs and Training Engineering projects - EHS-Providing construction, modernization and plant projects - Participation in Design Reviews, Change Controls, HAZOPs, PSSR and technical decreases - Ensure compliance with global CSL-Technical Standards - (e.g. LOTO, Machine and Plant Safety, Chemical Management, Permit-to-Work) - Technical coordination of the EHS specialists:inside the project environment Compliance & Management System - Ensuring compliance with ISO 45001, relevant Swiss legislation and internal CSL standards - Care and development of processes, documentation and work instructions - Support for audits, certifications, government contacts Coaching, Stakeholder Management & Communication - Advice and coaching of executives and teams in dealing with risks, standards and security - Translating complex technical risks into clear, understandable recommendations for action - Promoting sustainable EHS culture in all areas
• Requirements & qualifications Experience - 8–10 years of professional experience in the field of EHS, Technical Safety or Risk Engineering - ideal in regulated industry (Pharma, Chemistry, Biotech, Energy, Mechanical Engineering) - Detectional experience in the moderation of systematic risk analyses - Tested practice in Incident Investigations & Root-Cause Methods - Experience in supporting technical projects (construction, installations, processes) Qualification - Studies in safety engineering, engineering, chemistry, environment or comparable technical discipline - Funded knowledge in ISO 45001, technical safety standards and risk methods - Experience in handling hazardous materials, technical systems and process safety Leadership & Soft Skills - Strong communication and moderation capabilities - Ability to guide specialists and project teams professionally - Proactive, structured and solution-oriented operation - Secure appearance at all hierarchical levels Languages - German: insurance - English: very good Do you feel addressed? In CSL, crediamo che la nostra gente sia la nostra risorsa più preziosa nella nostra ricerca per salvare vite e proteggere la salute delle persone in tutto il mondo. Come partner EMEA Total Rewards, il vostro scopo è quello di garantire che ogni membro del team di tutta la regione si senta apprezzato e riconosciuto per il loro contributo. Gestire i quadri competitivi e giusti, non si sta solo guardando i fogli di calcolo – si sta costruendo la fondazione che permette ai nostri scienziati e professionisti di concentrarsi su ciò che fanno meglio: fornire terapie salvavita ai pazienti. L'opportunità Questo è un ruolo di partner altamente visibile in cui si agirà come consulente chiave nel nostro paesaggio di ricompense totali. Non sarà solo amministrare i piani; sarete il ponte strategico tra la strategia globale e l'esecuzione regionale. Collaborando a stretto contatto con HR Business Partners e Business Leaders, navigherete le complessità dei diversi mercati del lavoro in EMEA. La vostra esperienza sarà affidata a fornire informazioni basate sui dati per decisioni complesse di assunzione e conservazione, assicurando che CSL rimanga un datore di lavoro di scelta, mantenendo il nostro "Promesso" ai nostri dipendenti attraverso un'offerta completa e attraente. Principali responsabilità
• Partner Strategico: Agire come esperto di materia per le risorse umane e i leader aziendali, fornendo consigli consultivi e basati sui dati per complesse sfide di compensazione.
• Gestione del Programma Regionale: attuazione e gestione dei programmi di premiazione della CSL nella regione EMEA.
• Intelligenza di mercato: la partecipazione principale alle tendenze di mercato analizzando per garantire che le nostre strutture di ricompensa rimangano competitive ed equa.
• Allineamento globale: lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Global Compensation, Benefits e Equity per garantire che le esigenze regionali siano rappresentate in iniziative a livello aziendale, compresi i cicli di compensazione Workday.
• Compliance & Governance: supervisionare i requisiti di legge e garantire che tutte le pratiche di pagamento aderiscano alle leggi del lavoro locali e alla governance interna della CSL. Requisiti
• Qualifiche: è richiesto un Bachelor in Business, HR, Finanza o un campo correlato. Le certificazioni professionali (ad esempio, CCP o equivalente) sono altamente considerate.
• Esperienza: Esperienza significativa in Compensazione e Vantaggi, in particolare all'interno di una grande e complessa organizzazione multinazionale nella regione EMEA.

Position Purpose The Senior Quality Associate is responsible for managing deviations, investigations, CAPAs, product technical complaints and change controls associated with development activities and manufacture of Investigational Medicinal Product within CSL Clinical Development portfolio. To do this, the GMP Site Quality Associate has the primary purpose of ensuring compliance with GMP/GSP/GxP by providing front‑line quality guidance and support across all phases of Technical Product Development. You will also ensure self‑inspections are conducted and followed up in a timely manner and provide quality and compliance support throughout all aspects of technical product. Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Participate in IPT Project and associate delivery team meetings, providing quality/compliance leadership, guidance and advice
• Manage deviations and OOS investigations and facilitate/attend Deviation Review Board meetings as required
• Manage and facilitate the deviation meeting process, manage deviations to closure, including significant and complex deviations, to ensure that information recorded is comprehensive and remedial actions are appropriate and executed in a timely manner
• Facilitate change panel meetings, manage change controls to completion, including significant and complex changes, to ensure changes are appropriate and comply with regulatory requirements
• Liaison with Technical departments for quality assurance and compliance related issues
• Manage Product Technical Complaints and associated investigations
• Review and approve Technical Document Change Requests
• Conduct self‑inspections, provide reports in a timely manner, assess responses and provide quality advice to maintain regulatory compliance and continuous improvement
• Provide training in QMS principles as required
• Participate in updating of QA documents as relevant to Technical Development
• Provide QA compliance review and approval of relevant product documents
• Attend and manage Quality Risk Assessments (QRAs) as required
• Educate technical staff in GxP and quality system requirements
• Establish and maintain local and global product‑related Quality Agreements
• Position Qualifications and Experience Requirements Education A degree in a relevant biological science, with at least 3 years’ experience in at least one of the following areas:
• Manufacturing under GMP
• Regulatory Affairs
• Quality Assurance
• Relevant Process Development Essential Skills, Knowledge and Attributes
• In‑depth understanding of GMP requirements in the pharmaceutical industry and previous Production, Quality or R&D experience within the pharmaceutical industry
• Sound knowledge of processes for Clinical Trial GMP manufacture
• Understanding of the product development process and environment is desirable
• Good interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills
• Ability to relate to and communicate with people of different technical skill backgrounds and at different levels from management to operations within CSL
• Good analytical and problem‑solving skills
• Ability to work well independently and to self‑motivate
• Well‑developed organisational and time management skills
• PC skills (Microsoft Office)
• Strong oral and written communication skills
• Team orientated
• Strong customer focus About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggetto Scienziato senior con un alto livello di esperienza nella biofisica proteica per caratterizzare una varietà di proteine terapeutiche. L'incumbent applica un forte background tecnico in biomolecole caratterizzazione a entusiasmanti progetti interdisciplinari che lavorano in un ambiente di team collaborativo sulle strumentazioni all'avanguardia. Collabora con altri scienziati e partner esterni per sviluppare saggi analitici idonei all'uso, suggerire flussi di lavoro e fornire supporto tecnico e formazione per consentire processi critici decisionali e sostenere continue attività di sviluppo della droga. In questa posizione, un elevato livello di conoscenza delle tecniche biofisiche è essenziale per fornire analisi analitiche appropriate di fase e per supportare una maggiore caratterizzazione del prodotto. Lo scienziato senior contribuirà a tradurre piattaforme innovative e nuove tecnologie in metodi completamente sviluppati e possibilmente automatizzati. L'entusiasmo scientifico, la creatività, l'esperienza di laboratorio e l'impegno saranno essenziali per il successo del team e degli obiettivi e dei tempi organizzativi. Principali responsabilità e responsabilità
• Responsabile per la progettazione e l'esecuzione di esperimenti e per l'interpretazione dei risultati delle tecniche basate sulla biofisica e sulla cromatografia per supportare la caratterizzazione di nuovi prodotti derivati dal plasma e prodotti commercializzati.
• Sviluppo e implementazione di nuovi metodi analitici in base alla qualità analitica mediante principi di progettazione e qualifica appropriata in fase secondo le esigenze del progetto e del prodotto.
• Atto come Soggetto Matter Expert (SME) per argomenti relativi alla biofisica e alla cromatografia per fornire un contributo scientifico a più progetti e per l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie.
• Sostenere il trasferimento di metodi qualificati da R&D a ambiente regolamentato presso il sito appropriato (QC, CROs).
• Procedure di laboratorio, protocolli, relazioni e SOP per partner interni e/o esterni.
• Presente a seminari e conferenze interni ed esterni.
• Responsabile per il funzionamento degli strumenti, la risoluzione dei problemi e la manutenzione.
• Utilizzare efficacemente le risorse (tempo, persone, attrezzature e materiali).
• Fornisci un feedback appropriato agli altri membri del team.
• Collaborare con i membri del gruppo e incrociare i team funzionali per sostenere gli studi analitici, lo sviluppo dei processi e altri studi.
• Assicurare una stretta collaborazione con altre funzioni CSL locali e globali in tutta la rete. Istruzione
• Laurea post-laurea (preferibilmente PhD) in scienze biologiche, biofisica o chimica analitica. Esperienza
• 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria biofarmaceutica nel campo della caratterizzazione della biomolecola mediante cromatografia e approcci biofisici.
• Esperienza nello sviluppo di metodologie analitiche per la caratterizzazione qualitativa e quantitativa delle proteine utilizzando diverse tecniche biofisiche e cromatografiche.
• Esperienza teorica e pratica approfondita su diverse tecniche biofisiche (come SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluorescence, FTIR) per l'analisi della struttura e della conformazione delle proteine.
• La conoscenza della caratterizzazione delle particelle sub-visibili utilizzando tecnologie come la microscopia di flusso, DLS, l'analisi di tracciamento di Nano è preferita.
• L'esperienza con varie tecniche di cromatografia (ad esempio SEC-HPLC, RP-HPLC, CE) è considerata un vantaggio.
• Esperienza pratica e conoscenza nel funzionamento e nella manutenzione di diversi tipi di strumenti (struzioni spettroscopiche, LC).
• Buona comprensione del processo scientifico, tra cui lo sviluppo di ipotesi e il design sperimentale (DoE) con la capacità di catturare e registrare dati scientifici complessi con precisione e affidabilità. Competenze
• Forte competenza nella biofisica delle proteine e nella caratterizzazione della biomolecola.
• Conoscenza avanzata delle tecniche analitiche biofisiche e cromatografiche.
• Capacità di progettare, eseguire e interpretare complessi esperimenti analitici.
• Forte capacità di risoluzione e risoluzione dei problemi scientifici.
• Capacità di supportare lo sviluppo del metodo
descriptionByLocale.en:
Position Purpose Senior Scientist with high level of experience in protein biophysics to characterize a variety of therapeutic proteins. The incumbent applies a strong technical background in biomolecules characterization to exciting interdisciplinary projects working in a collaborative team environment on state-of-the-art instrumentations. He/she will partner with other scientists and external partners to develop fit-for-purpose analytical assays, suggest workflows and provide technical support and training to enable critical process decision-making and support continuous drug development activities. In this position, a high level of knowledge of biophysical techniques is essential to deliver phase appropriate analytical assays and to support enhanced product characterization. The Senior Scientist will contribute to translate innovative platforms and new technologies into fully developed, possibly automated methods. Scientific enthusiasm, creativity, hands-on lab experience and commitment will be essential for the successful achievement of team and organizational goals and timelines. Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Responsible for designing and performing experiments as well as for interpreting results from biophysical and chromatography-based techniques to support characterization of new plasma-derived product and commercialized product.
• Development and implementation of novel analytical methods according to analytic quality by design principles and phase-appropriate qualification according to project and product demands.
• Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for biophysical and chromatography related topics to provide scientific input to multiple projects and for the implementation of new technologies.
• Support the transfer of qualified methods from R&D to regulated environment at the appropriate site (QC, CROs).
• Author lab procedures, protocols, reports and SOPs for internal and/or external partners.
• Present at internal and external seminars and conferences.
• Responsible for instruments operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
• Make effective use of resources (time, people, equipment and materials).
• Provide appropriate feedback to other team members.
• Collaborate with group members and cross functional teams to support analytical studies, process development, and other studies.
• Ensure close collaboration with other local and global CSL functions across the proper network. Education
• Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in biological sciences, biophysics or analytical chemistry. Experience
• 3+ years of biopharmaceutical industry experience in the field of biomolecule characterization by chromatography and biophysical approaches.
• Experience in the development of analytical methodologies for qualitative and quantitative characterization of proteins using different biophysical and chromatographic techniques.
• In-depth theoretical and extensive hands-on experience on diverse biophysical techniques (e.g. SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluorescence, FTIR) for analysis of protein structure and conformation.
• Knowledge of sub-visible particles characterization using technologies such as Flow Microscopy, DLS, Nano Tracking Analysis is preferred.
• Experience with various chromatography techniques (e.g. SEC-HPLC, RP-HPLC, CE) is considered a plus.
• Hands-on experience and knowledge in the operation and maintenance of different types of instruments (spectroscopic, LC instrumentations).
• Good understanding of scientific process, including hypothesis development and experimental design (DoE) with ability to capture and record complex scientific data accurately and reliably. Competencies
• Strong expertise in protein biophysics and biomolecule characterization.
• Advanced knowledge of biophysical and chromatographic analytical techniques.
• Ability to design, execute and interpret complex analytical experiments.
• Strong scientific problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to support method developm

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Sarete responsabili per la progettazione e l'esecuzione della strategia clinica per sostenere lo sviluppo di un farmaco, allineato con il documento di strategia di progetto (PSD) e il profilo del prodotto target (TPP). Questa posizione è responsabile per la supervisione clinica e scientifica del programma assegnato e: - assicura standard clinici e scientifici di alta qualità sono soddisfatti durante tutti gli aspetti del programma - fornire supervisione clinica e competenze durante lo sviluppo di studi clinici - serve come monitor medico per gli studi clinici assegnati o fornisce la supervisione di un monitor medico assegnato - funge da rappresentante per lo sviluppo clinico sui team di consegna interfunzionali richiesti (DT) Questa posizione è un “Autore di piombo” o “Autore di contributo” per: - documenti chiave di studio, inclusi, ma non limitati al Piano di Sviluppo Clinico (CDP), il Documento di Strategia di Progetto (PSD), Brochure di Investigatore (IB), Protocolli di Studio Clinico (CSP), Forme di Consenso Informate (ICF), Piani di Monitoraggio Medico (MMP), Rapporti di Studio Clinico (CSR). - le sezioni cliniche dei relativi pacchetti normativi (ad esempio IND, NDA, relazioni annuali) e supporto RFI normativi secondo le necessità. - lo sviluppo di astratti, presentazioni e manoscritti come appropriato. • providing clinical oversight and expertise during development of clinical studies
• serves as medical monitor for assigned clinical trials or provides oversight to an assigned medical monitor

• the clinical sections of relevant regulatory packages (e.g. IND, NDA, annual reports) and support regulatory RFIs as needed.

• Ensures that the program is conducted in alignment with CSL Behring processes and abiding by GCP and ICH regulations.
• Responsible for driving and documenting decision making within the CDT, facilitating issue resolution and escalation, as well as contingency planning. 2 Clinical & Scientific Oversight:
• Accountable for the clinical content for all CDT deliverables to ensure safe, efficient, and timely execution of assigned clinical programs.
• Ensures high quality clinical and scientific standards are met throughout all aspects of the program.
• Serves as the clinical development representative on the required cross-functional Delivery Teams (DT) including but not limited to the Safety Management Team (SMT), the Benefit-Risk Assessment Team (BRAT), the Biomarker Expert Team (BET), and the Evidence and Access Strategy Team (EAST) for assigned programs.
• Develops and executes the Medical Monitoring Plan (MMP) strategy. Typically serves as the medical monitor for clinical trials during study conduct or provides oversight to assigned medical monitors.
• Presents results to Safety Monitoring Committee and other internal and external meetings. 3 Document Authorship:

• Leads preparations of clinical sections of relevant regulatory interaction packages including but not limited to briefing books, INDs, NDAs. BLAs, ODDs, RFIs, and routine reporting.
• Contributing author the publication strategy. Author or contributing author for abstracts, presentations, and manuscripts as appropriate. Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

Descrizione Vous serez responsable de la conception et de l'exécution de la stratégie clinique pour appuyer l'élaboration d'un médicament, conformément au Document de stratégie du projet (DSP) et au Profil du produit cible (PPT). Vous êtes également responsable du leadership stratégique de l'équipe de développement clinique (ECC) dans un environnement matriciel et vous êtes responsable : - l'élaboration et l'exécution opportunes du Plan de développement clinique (PDC). - gérer les activités quotidiennes du CDT, y compris, sans s'y limiter, la coordination et la documentation des réunions, la prise de décisions et la gestion des intervenants. - s'assurer que le programme est mené en conformité avec les processus de consanguinité de la LSC et qu'il est conforme aux règlements du GCP et de l'ICH. Ce poste est responsable de la surveillance clinique et scientifique du ou des programmes assignés et : - s'assure que les normes cliniques et scientifiques de haute qualité sont respectées pendant tous les aspects du programme - fournir une surveillance clinique et une expertise pendant le développement des études cliniques - sert de moniteur médical pour les essais cliniques assignés ou assure la surveillance d'un moniteur médical assigné - est le représentant du développement clinique des équipes de prestation interfonctionnelles (DT) Cette position est un Auteur Lead ou Auteur Contribuant pour: - les principaux documents d'étude, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le Plan de développement clinique (PDC), le Document de stratégie du projet (DSP), les Brochures des chercheurs (IB), les Protocoles d'étude clinique (PSC), les Formulaires de consentement éclairé (FIC), les Plans de surveillance médicale (PMM), les Rapports d'étude clinique (REC). - les sections cliniques des trousses réglementaires pertinentes (p. ex. IND, NDA, rapports annuels) et appuyer les DDR réglementaires au besoin. - l'élaboration de résumés, de présentations et de manuscrits selon les besoins. Comité d'examen stratégique et technique (CRST) pour approbation du plan d'étude. - S'assure que le programme est mené en conformité avec les processus CSL Behring et qu'il est conforme aux règlements GCP et ICH. - Responsable de la conduite et de la documentation de la prise de décisions au sein du CDT, facilitant la résolution des problèmes et l'escalade, ainsi que la planification d'urgence. 2 Surveillance clinique et scientifique : - Rendre compte du contenu clinique de tous les produits livrables des CDT afin d'assurer l'exécution sécuritaire, efficace et en temps opportun des programmes cliniques assignés. - S'assurer que les normes cliniques et scientifiques de haute qualité sont respectées dans tous les aspects du programme. - Assure le rôle de représentant du développement clinique dans les équipes de prestation interfonctionnelles requises, y compris, sans s'y limiter, l'équipe de gestion de la sécurité (EMS), l'équipe d'évaluation des risques et des avantages (EAR), l'équipe d'experts en biomarqueurs (EAR) et l'équipe de stratégie sur les preuves et l'accès (EAR) pour les programmes assignés. - Élaborer et exécuter la stratégie du Plan de surveillance médicale. Habituellement, il sert de moniteur médical pour les essais cliniques au cours de l'étude ou assure la surveillance des moniteurs médicaux affectés. - Présente les résultats au Comité de surveillance de la sécurité et à d'autres réunions internes et externes. 3 Auteur du document : - Examiner les données générées au cours de la planification et de l'exécution d'une étude afin de recueillir une compréhension clinique des résultats en matière d'innocuité et d'efficacité ainsi que de l'incidence des données sur les stratégies de R-D en cours et aider à définir la stratégie de développement. - Dirige la préparation des sections cliniques des trousses d'interaction réglementaire pertinentes, y compris, sans s'y limiter, les cahiers d'information, les IND et les ADN. BLA, ODD, DDR et rapports de routine. - Contribuer à la stratégie de publication. Auteur ou auteur contributeur pour les résumés, les présentations et les manuscrits selon le cas.

Mansioni Senior Biostatistician Descrizione del lavoro Il Senior Biostatistician fornisce e può guidare i contributi statistici a un programma di sviluppo clinico. Il Principal Biostatistician implementa le strategie statistiche per gli studi clinici e le presentazioni regolamentari all'interno del programma e ne è responsabile per tutte le consegne statistiche. Mansioni e Responsabilità Principali - Contribuire alla strategia statistica e assicurarsi che le metodologie statistiche appropriate siano applicate al progetto e all'analisi dei dati per gli studi clinici e le presentazioni regolamentari. - Fornire supporto statistico per la raccolta, l'analisi, la segnalazione e la preparazione delle presentazioni. - Assicurarsi del potenziale tempestaivo e della qualità del Piano di Analisi Statistica (SAP). - Supportare gli scambi biostatistici con le autorità regolamentari (ad esempio, FDA, EMA, PMDA). - Interpretare i risultati dell'analisi e assicurarsi dell'accuratezza e chiarezza della segnalazione. - Gestire le attività statistiche esternalizzate o collabora con i programmatori statistici interni; assicurarsi della tempesti e della qualità delle consegne dei CRO/FSP e perdite le revisioni della qualità. - Sorvegliare la Tabelle, Figure e Liste (TFLs) e dei pacchetti CDISC per i rapporti di studio e le preparazioni regolamentari. - Supportare le iniziative di miglioramento continuo e contributo alle norme relative all'eliminazione, ai processi e alla consulenza scientifica.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to standards related to infrastructure, processes, and scientific consulting. Job Qualifications and Experience Requirements Education

Job Description: The engineering Associate Director of Sustaining Engineering is a new role within CSL’s Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP). This role will provide technical leadership to support marketed combination products. The individual will work with DDSP and peer departments, e.g., Quality Assurance, to implement changes and improvements to combination products to ensure safety and reliability. Changes may include process optimization, CDMO evaluation, tech transfers, supplier-related changes, and risk management updates. This role will also identify and leverage best practices supporting the needs of a diverse combination product portfolio as well as formalizing and standardizing approaches. This role serves as a key interface between DDSP, project teams, External Organizations, Commercial, and corporate initiatives for scoping and vetting design improvement projects. Responsibilities:
• The role ensures all sustaining activities are conducted in compliance with applicable standards and regulations including ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 4, QMSR, and 211, and relevant ICH guidelines.
• Partner with manufacturing, CDMOs, and quality to drive design improvements, process optimizations, and supplier changes through the appropriate change control and regulatory pathways.
• The Associate Director represents the function in cross-functional program teams, design reviews, and regulatory interactions, providing expert input on device reliability to Health Authority submissions (e.g., NDA/BLA device sections).
• The Associate Director supports regulatory audits and inspections and maintains a deep understanding of the evolving combination product regulatory landscape.
• Monitor and provide input into product complaint process to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Provide key insights and lessons learned to educate new product development leads on best practices.
• Utilize technical project management skills, including resource planning, work planning, risk management, prioritization, conflict management, change management, issue resolution, and progress reporting.
• Responsible for identifying and implementing requirements for safety, quality, and reliability are effectively met for CSL commercialized combination products. Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor’s in engineering (mechanical or chemical preferred)
• Minimum 10 years of experience in either parenteral or device manufacturing in the pharmaceutical space
• Leadership experience in team management or supervision
• Experience with manufacturing processes, validation practices, and cGMP guidelines
• Knowledge of process automation and equipment reliability
• Ability to collaborate with internal teams, CMs, and contractors About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ . Job Description: The Director of Secondary Packaging is a leadership role within CSL’s Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP) department. In this position, you will have the opportunity to shape how medicines are delivered to CSL’s patients, advance global sustainability objectives, and drive category transformation by developing long-term strategies. This includes overseeing the transition from conventional materials and processes to innovative, patient-focused, and environmentally sustainable solutions. In this role, you will influence and drive complex global category strategies across CSL’s product portfolio working with manufacturing, supply chain, technical operations (including primary packaging, device, and human factors areas within DDSP), quality, commercial, regulatory, and procurement. You will act as a thought leader in technology, sustainability, and supplier innovation, steering CSL packaging strategy toward future‑ready solutions. Responsibilities
• Evolve secondary packaging development processes – you will champion new processes, the adoption of new tools, data driven decision making, and advanced technologies across the packaging value chain. This will also include integration into combination product development processes.
• Develop secondary packaging designs and capabilities to ensure that CSL products meet market, regulatory compliance, quality, and manufacturing requirements. Assess secondary packaging failures to determine root causes and corrective actions.
• Deliver meaningful sustainability impact – you will shape initiatives that will ensure we meet global environmental commitments.
• Contribute to a high-performing global supplier network – partner with supply chain and procurement on: supplier partnerships to drive innovation pipelines and ensure resilience and quality of our global packaging supply base.
• Professional knowledge to coach and mentor direct reports and to provide career development for team members.
• Responsible for creating workforce plans, succession plans, and staffing plans for to ensure available talent is maximized to achieve business results for CSL. Qualifications
• Packaging or other Engineering degree.
• At least 10 years of related experience in secondary packaging within the medical device and or pharmaceutical industry.
• Expertise in serialization and other anticounterfeit measures
• Experience with ISTA and ASTM for packaging and simulated shipping.
• Proven ability to develop strategies and lead improvement projects.
• Excellent communication skills and a track record working in a matrix environment; Influencing/building/promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
• Strong leadership through a partnership and engagement approach with manufacturing for advancing quality outcomes and operational excellence. descriptionByLocale.en:
The Analytical Strategy Director is a senior scientific and strategic leadership role responsible for designing and overseeing analytical strategies that support drug discovery, development, and regulatory approval. This position ensures robust, compliant, and innovative analytical approaches across preclinical, clinical programs and LCM.​

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities​

Strategic Leadership​:

• Develop and lead the global analytical strategy aligned with program and corporate goals​

• Provide scientific and regulatory guidance for analytical plans across all development phases (discovery → post-marketing)​

• Drive innovation in analytical technologies, platforms, and workflows​

• Represent analytical function in cross-functional governance and decision-making forums​

Scientific Oversight​:

• Oversee development, validation, and implementation of analytical methods (e.g., LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, immunogenicity)​

• Ensure high-quality data generation for PK, PD, biomarker, and immunogenicity studies​

• Review and approve analytical study designs, reports, and regulatory documentation​

• Troubleshoot complex scientific and technical challenges​

Regulatory & Compliance​:

• Ensure compliance with global regulatory guidelines (FDA, EMA, ICH, GLP, GCP)​

• Lead analytical sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, NDA, BLA, MAA)​

• Interface with regulatory agencies and respond to health authority queries​

• Maintain inspection readiness and quality standards​

Cross-Functional Collaboration:​

• Partner with Clinical Pharmacology, DMPK, Toxicology, Biomarkers, and Clinical Operations​

• Support translational strategy and dose selection decisions​

• Manage external CROs, academic collaborators, and technology vendors​

Leadership & Management:​

• Lead and mentor analytical scientists and project leaders​

• Manage budgets, timelines, and resource allocation​

• Build and scale analytical capabilities and infrastructure​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements​

• PhD in analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or related field (or MSc with extensive experience)​

• Typically 12–15+ years in bioanalysis within biotech, pharma, or CRO environments​

• Deep expertise in LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, and immunogenicity testing​

• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements and analytical validation standards​

• Proven leadership and strategic program experience​

• Experience supporting regulatory submissions and health authority interactions​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, fos

The Scientist, Tech Ops researches and develops new medicines for unmet medical needs through innovative medical science from inception, through clinical trials to commercialization. Assesses, monitors and ensures products meet clinical safety standards. Conducts sophisticated analysis, manages research information systems and technical documentation. May be involved in providing para-professional laboratory support for product testing after collection. Establishes relationship with regulatory authorities to establish and maintain registration licenses to sell products globally.​ Designs and implements business experimental processes to enable product research and development. Designs related integrated process and candidate / product team activities and directs technical and operational activities to ensure planned project outcomes, and enables portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, and risk management. Provides and contributes to project progression and reports, as required, to project or program committees for decision-making support. Leads teams in the development of program and project strategy, and lifecycle management planning. Develops systems to support dynamic portfolio management. Serves a key role in portfolio evaluation process. Drives initiatives across research and development units to create fully integrated strategies. Monitors and reports on portfolio status and proactively addresses and resolves issues. May design and develop manufacturing processes for new or existing products, taking into consideration problems inherent in the transfer of technology from research to manufacturing. Develops procedures for the economical mass production in cooperation with pilot-plant and production departments. Conducts tests and measurements throughout stages of production to determine control over applicable variables. As required, will need to operate within the current regulatory and compliance environments.​ Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities​
• Contributes technology platform capabilities to team in order to achieve designated project objectives. ​
• Coordinates global and local research and development projects.​
• Manages collaboration with different CSL sites and external partners.​
• Applies practical knowledge of job area typically obtained through advanced education and work experience​
• Works independently with general supervision to achieve operational targets with direct impact on departmental results​
• Problems faced are difficult but typically not complex, sometimes requiring understanding of broader set of issues​
• May influence others within the job area through explanation of facts, policies, and practices​ Qualifications & Experience Requirements​
• Bachelors or postgraduate degree and /or extensive experience in relevant discipline.​
• Minimum 3 years' laboratory experience with training in a relevant technical discipline e.g., molecular and cellular biology, analytical biochemistry etc.​
• Different qualifications or responsibilities may apply based on local legal and/or educational requirements. Refer to local job documentation where applicable.​ Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application. About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. descriptionByLocale.en:
Senior Scientist (Pathogen Safety) Position Description Summary​ The Senior Scientist, Tech Ops contributes to routine technical tasks and supports project teams by performing specific functions such as conducting experiments and analysing data to enable product research and development. You may design and develop manufacturing processes for new or existing products, taking into consideration problems inherent in the transfer of technology from research to manufacturing. You will apply practical knowledge of relevant process unit operations and work independently with general supervision to achieve operational targets with direct impact on departmental results. Additionally, you will support project progression by preparing reports and materials for project or program committees to enable informed decision‑making. You will conduct tests and measurements throughout stages of production to determine control over applicable variables, and as required, will need to operate within the current regulatory and compliance environments. Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities​
• Applies advanced knowledge of job area obtained through a postgraduate degree in biological sciences/biotechnology and extensive experience in biopharmaceutical process development ​
• • Manage projects/processes related to virus reduction studies and in partnership with relevant internal and external stakeholders, working independently with limited supervision​
• Coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals​ (Scientists and contingent workers/professional services)
• Problems faced are difficult and sometimes complex, often requiring understanding of broader set of issues​
• • Provides scientific expertise and guidance in the design as well as the application of virus reduction studies and overall product development activities in close collaboration with other subject matter experts within and across the integrated product teams. ​
• • Ensures high quality in the application of virus reduction studies to support designated project objectives. ​
• Contributes to the planning, performance, evaluation and reporting of scientific experiments at the highest levels of scientific integrity. ​
• Works together with and provide expertise to other team members to achieve specified process development objectives within defined time parameters. Qualifications & Experience Requirements​
• Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in Life Sciences (virology, cell biology, biochemistry, etc) and a minimum of 3 years’ experience in industrial environment, especially in the process science/process development area. ​

## Descrizione

For our CSL Behring Operations / Manufacturing, we are looking for a Head of Manufacturing Engineering and Maintenance

Closing Date for Applications – 17th April 2026

The Head of Manufacturing Engineering & Maintenance is a strategic leader responsible for the reliability and lifecycle management of manufacturing assets. This role oversees Calibration & Metrology Engineering, Manufacturing Maintenance, Reliability Engineering, Production/System Owner Engineering, and Shutdown Planning & Scheduling. Key responsibilities support critical operations, including fractionation, bulk production, and packaging, while ensuring equipment readiness and compliance with regulatory standards in the biopharmaceutical sector. The position also requires strong skills in labour relations to foster collaboration within a unionized workforce.
Role that this position reports to: Engineering & Maintenance Site Head

## Job Purpose

- Direct all aspects of manufacturing engineering and maintenance, including technical support, project management, emergency response, on-call, troubleshooting and corrective, preventive/predictive maintenance
- Ensure facilities and equipment are designed, operated and maintained in compliance with cGMP, Health Authorities (i.e. FDA), EHS
- Drives execution of qualification plans, risk analysis, metrology, data integrity and general GMP issues
- Lead the planning, budgeting, execution and commissioning of major capital projects, facility expansions, and technology upgrades
- Champion asset lifecycle management, reliability engineering and implementation
- Oversees sites workshop operations
- Develop, communicate and execute an engineering and maintenance strategy
- Lead transformation initiatives, including digitalization, advanced automation, sustainability and adoption of cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
- Supports the development and implementation of multi-year strategic plans, capital investment roadmaps and operational readiness programs for all global site
- Lead the sites manufacturing engineering and maintenance organization
- Oversee deviation management, investigation of deviations and establishment of corrective and preventive actions plus develop, monitor and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for engineering and maintenance
- Represent the local manufacturing engineering and maintenance function in regulatory inspections, audit readiness
- Champion the use of digital tools and data analytics (e.g., SAP, Trackwise, FMS, Ariba, Power BI, Smart Sheet, Tableau) and implement CSL Operating System, Six Sigma, Lean
- Conducts regular GEMBAS
- Oversee the management of GMP/non-GMP facility systems
- Manage relationships with external service providers, contractors and vendors
- Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain, IT and other departments
- Engage with global and regional leadership
- Lead, mentor and develop a diverse, cross-functional team
- Oversees assigned cost centres, monitors performances and acts on trends
- Develops budgets for OpEx and headcounts

## Your Skills and Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical) required, a master’s preferred
- Minimum of ten years’ experience in the pharmaceutical, food, or chemical process industry
- At least five years of technical management or leadership experience
- Significant expertise in GMP/non-GMP manufacturing assets related to pharmaceutical production
- Expertise in sterile manufacturing, bulk production and finishing and packaging operations of (bio) pharmaceuticals
- Experience managing union and non-union workforces
- Advanced skills in facility management systems (Trackwise, SAP, FMS, Ariba, DCMS) and digital tools (MS Project, Excel, Power BI, Smart Sheet, Tableau)
- Knowledge of Six Sigma/Lean principles
- Financial acumen in managing multimillion-dollar budgets
- Experience with global health authorities’ inspections, audits and regulatory agencies

Descrizione

In questo ruolo, guiderai attività normative sia strategiche che operative all'interno di un'area terapeutica (TA) assegnata nelle regioni APAC, LATAM e delle aziende partner. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con le parti interessate globali e regionali per garantire approvazioni normative tempestive e una gestione efficace del ciclo di vita per i prodotti designati. Collaborando con il responsabile dell'area terapeutica e con il responsabile della regolamentazione globale, contribuirai alle strategie normative globali adattando ed eseguendo strategie regionali in linea con le priorità aziendali e commerciali. Questa è un’entusiasmante opportunità per svolgere un ruolo chiave nel portare terapie critiche ai pazienti nei mercati internazionali dinamici e in rapida crescita. Responsabilità chiave: agire come responsabile della regolamentazione regionale per i prodotti e i paesi assegnati, garantendo l'allineamento con la strategia e le priorità normative globali. - Sviluppare e implementare strategie normative regionali che supportino le registrazioni dei prodotti, la gestione del ciclo di vita e gli obiettivi aziendali. - Identificare percorsi efficienti di approvazione normativa in collaborazione con i rappresentanti locali delle autorità di regolamentazione (LRR) e i rappresentanti dei partner normativi (RPR). - Contribuire alle attività del Global Regulatory Affairs Strategy Team (GRAST) e supportare lo sviluppo di strategie normative globali. - Guidare e supervisionare le attività normative in tutto il portafoglio assegnato, identificando e gestendo in modo proattivo i rischi normativi. - Garantire comunicazioni normative e risposte di alta qualità alle domande dell'Autorità sanitaria in linea con i requisiti e le tempistiche regionali. - Collaborare strettamente con le parti interessate interne, gli LRR e gli RPR per supportare approvazioni tempestive e conformità normativa. - Costruire e mantenere forti rapporti con le autorità sanitarie regionali attraverso una comunicazione efficace e una documentazione di alta qualità. - Rimani informato sulla legislazione normativa internazionale, sulle linee guida e sugli sviluppi del settore rilevanti per i prodotti e le attività CSL. - Valutare l'impatto dell'evoluzione delle normative locali e regionali e fornire valutazioni del rischio normativo. - Supportare iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare i processi normativi, la conformità e l'eccellenza operativa. Qualifiche ed esperienza Istruzione: laurea in scienze biologiche, scienze mediche, farmacia o un campo correlato. - Le qualifiche post-laurea o la specializzazione in Drug Regulatory Affairs sono considerate un vantaggio. Esperienza - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in materia normativa nei mercati internazionali. - È altamente auspicabile ulteriore esperienza nel settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico. Capacità e competenze: è richiesto un inglese fluente. - Ulteriori lingue sono considerate una risorsa (ad esempio arabo, francese, spagnolo, russo). - Ottima conoscenza dello sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici e dei requisiti normativi. - Conoscenza dei principi GMP e GCP. - Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, gestione degli stakeholder e organizzative. - Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente globale e interfunzionale. Perché unirsi a noi? Si tratta di un'opportunità unica per contribuire alla fornitura di terapie che cambiano la vita ai pazienti di tutto il mondo, lavorando in un ambiente globale collaborativo e innovativo. Noi di CSL siamo impegnati nel miglioramento continuo, nell’eccellenza scientifica e nel fare una differenza significativa nella vita dei pazienti. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes mondiales et régionales pour garantir les approbations réglementaires en temps opportun et une gestion réussie du cycle de vie des produits désignés. Il s’agit d’une opportunité passionnante de jouer un rôle clé en apportant des thérapies essentielles aux patients sur des marchés internationaux dynamiques et en croissance rapide. Principales responsabilités - Agir en tant que responsable régional de la réglementation pour les produits et les pays assignés, en assurant l'alignement avec la stratégie et les priorités réglementaires mondiales. - Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies réglementaires régionales qui soutiennent les enregistrements de produits, la gestion du cycle de vie et les objectifs commerciaux. - Identifier les voies d'approbation réglementaires efficaces en collaboration avec les représentants réglementaires locaux (LRR) et les représentants des partenaires réglementaires (RPR). - Contribuer aux activités de l'équipe de stratégie des affaires réglementaires mondiales (GRAST) et soutenir le développement de stratégies réglementaires mondiales. - Diriger et superviser les activités réglementaires dans l'ensemble du portefeuille assigné, en identifiant et en gérant de manière proactive les risques réglementaires. - Assurer des soumissions réglementaires de haute qualité et des réponses aux questions des autorités sanitaires conformément aux exigences et aux délais régionaux. - Collaborer étroitement avec les parties prenantes internes, les LRR et les RPR pour soutenir les approbations en temps opportun et la conformité réglementaire. - Établir et entretenir des relations solides avec les autorités sanitaires régionales grâce à une communication efficace et une documentation de haute qualité. - Restez informé de la législation réglementaire internationale, des lignes directrices et des développements de l'industrie pertinents pour les produits et activités de CSL. - Évaluer l'impact de l'évolution des réglementations locales et régionales et fournir des évaluations des risques réglementaires. - Soutenir les initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus réglementaires, la conformité et l'excellence opérationnelle.
• Qualifications et expérience Éducation - Diplôme en sciences biologiques, en sciences médicales, en pharmacie ou dans un domaine connexe. - Des diplômes de troisième cycle ou une spécialisation en affaires réglementaires pharmaceutiques sont considérés comme un avantage. Expérience - Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en affaires réglementaires sur les marchés internationaux. - Une expérience supplémentaire dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique est hautement souhaitable. Aptitudes et compétences - Un anglais courant est requis. - Des langues supplémentaires sont considérées comme un atout (par exemple, arabe, français, espagnol, russe). - Forte compréhension du développement de produits pharmaceutiques et des exigences réglementaires. - Connaissance des principes GMP et GCP. - Excellentes compétences en communication, en gestion des parties prenantes et en organisation. - Capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement global et interfonctionnel. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Il s’agit d’une opportunité unique de contribuer à la fourniture de thérapies qui changent la vie des patients du monde entier, tout en travaillant dans un environnement mondial collaboratif et innovant. Chez CSL, nous nous engageons à l’amélioration continue, à l’excellence scientifique et à faire une différence significative dans la vie des patients. À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un leader mondial des biothérapeutiques animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Axés sur la satisfaction des besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et proposons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant avec des maladies dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l’immunologie, de l’hématologie, des maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et de transplantation. Nous utilisons trois plates-formes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement du plasma, de technologie des protéines recombinantes et de thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Principal Statistical Programmer is responsible for providing leadership and hands-on support in the development and maintenance of the CSL statistical programming capabilities which is required to meet regulatory obligations. The individual will work closely with the Associate Director, Director, and Statistical Programmers to build internal programming tools. This individual, working closely with the study team, will be responsible for review and acceptance of contract research organization (CRO) deliverables which are mainly, but not limited to, datasets in submission ready standard format (ADaM), tables, figures, listings and submission packages. This individual will provide expertise in the design, development and quality control process for SAS programs used to access, extract, transform, review, analyze and submit clinical data for all requested analyses. This individual will collaborate with other departments (eg, Biostatistics, Data Management, Regulatory Operations, Medical Writing, ESP teams) to ensure Standard Operating Procedures are followed and the correct study data are used for all requests. This individual will participate in department and cross functional technology development and process improvement initiatives. Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
• Collaborates with the study teams to design data structure and specifications for ad hoc and study deliverables including, but not limited to ADaM datasets, Tables, Figures, Listings and Analysis Submission content. Plans and leads the production and validation efforts for the designed output, this may include oversight of work by CROs.
• Collaborates with study teams to ensure the quality and accuracy – thus submission readiness – of clinical data as required by authorities (i.e. SDTM, ADaM, tables, figures, listings, define.xml). Supports the review of related deliverables when provided by CROs.
• Leads and oversees requested efforts for pooled and exploratory analyses working closely with Statistics TA lead and/or study statisticians as well as with clinical programming team and their collection of legacy data.
• Leads and oversees the in-house specification and delivery of ISS and ISE datasets and associated output (tables, figures and listings) when not provided by CRO.
• Leads and oversees the design and implementation of complex SAS programs for applications designed to analyze and report complex clinical trial data in CDISC ADaM format.
• Leads and oversees the development of global tools that will increase the efficiency and capacity of the Statistical Programming group.
• Works closely with clinical study teams to execute activities to ensure project timelines are met with high quality deliverables. Additional tasks: Collaborates with CR&D staff regarding data analysis requests. Performs additional statistical analyses including but not limited to:
• support responses to regulatory agencies,
• generate integrated summary of safety and efficacy,
• support publications and presentations,
• support planning and reporting of clinical trials via exploratory analyses of available data,
• replicate CRO and CSL statistician analyses for QC Job Qualifications and Experience Requirements: Education
• BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or related area with relevant experience
• Other degrees and certifications considered if commensurate with related programming experience Experience
• At least 7 years of experience in either clinical programming and/or statistical programming, within the CRO/pharmaceutical environment using SAS Software.
• In-depth understanding of clinical programming and/or statistical programming processes and standards.
• In-depth understanding of regulatory requirements relevant to statistical programming (e.g. GCP, ICH).
• Extensive experience with statistical programming using the SAS software including development and use of SAS Macros. Strong programming and problem-solving skills.
• Advanced kn

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggetto

L'Enterprise Implementation Lead – Horizon 2 è un ruolo di leadership senior Technical Operations responsabile per l'implementazione e la validazione tecnica a livello aziendale del programma Horizon 2. Il programma Horizon 2 includeva una tecnologia brevettata, che migliora la resa di produzione che consente una produzione di immunoglobulina significativamente superiore dalla stessa quantità di base del plasma. Operando all'interno dell'organizzazione del programma Horizon 2, il ruolo serve come integratore primario di impresa in Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M), e consentendo progetti di capitale, garantendo l'intento tecnico, la maturità di processo, i risultati di validazione, gli apprendisti di programma e i contenuti tecnici conformi alle normative sono tradotti coerentemente in esecuzione efficace e sostenibile in scala.

Responsabilità del ruolo

Horizon 2 Programma Capacità tecniche
L'Enterprise Implementation Lead è responsabile per la consegna tecnica end-to-end del programma Horizon 2 attraverso lo sviluppo, l'implementazione del processo, il trasferimento tecnologico, la validazione e la creazione di sviluppo e contenuti tecnici necessari per supportare i processi normativi globali. Ciò include la traduzione di output di sviluppo in soluzioni di produzione scalabili e conformi e garantire che le conoscenze di processo, le strategie di controllo, le prove di validazione e le narrazioni tecniche conformi alle normative siano saldamente stabilite per consentire presentazioni di successo e la distribuzione in corso, nonché la nuova espansione attraverso la rete CSL.

• Guidare e integrare le attività di sviluppo tecnico attraverso l'implementazione del processo, garantendo continuità dell'intento tecnico e della prontezza per la produzione

• Definire ed eseguire strategie di implementazione di processi aziendali che convertono gli apprendimento di sviluppo in soluzioni pronte al sito, eseguibili in strutture nuove e esistenti

• Possedere e coordinare le responsabilità Tech Ops per il trasferimento di tecnologia, compresa la definizione di strategie di trasferimento, parametri di processo critici e criteri di successo in tutti i siti

• Tenere la responsabilità della strategia di validazione e dell'esecuzione associata al programma Horizon 2, assicurando che la validazione sia basata sul rischio, pronta all'ispezione e allineata alle aspettative normative

• Possedere allo sviluppo e all'integrazione dei contenuti tecnici e di sviluppo necessari per le presentazioni normative, assicurando la coerenza tra i dati di sviluppo, le prove di validazione e le narrazioni di archiviazione

• Assicurare l'allineamento tra i dati di sviluppo, i risultati delle qualifiche, le prove di validazione e i contenuti normativi per supportare la prontezza operativa e la produzione GMP sostenibile

• Drive Right-First-Time (RFT) consegna attraverso la gestione del rischio tecnico disciplinato, risoluzione dei problemi e processo decisionale basato sui dati

Collaborazione, integrazione e governance

• Partner con Manufacturing on Operational Readiness fornendo ingressi Tech Ops tra cui conoscenze di processo, requisiti di trasferimento tecnico, stato di validazione e trasparenza del rischio di processo

• Partner con Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) nella fornitura di progetti per garantire che i requisiti di processo, i parametri e i criteri di accettazione di Tech Ops siano chiaramente definiti e allineati con le aspettative di progettazione, costruzione, qualificazione e erogazione di asset

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli Affari di Qualità e Regolazione per sviluppare, rivedere e approvare strategie di validazione, contenuti di presentazione normativi e narrazioni di prontezza di ispezione, garantendo l'allineamento tra esecuzione tecnica e impegni normativi

• Mantenere il registro di rischio tecnico, convalida e regolamentare a livello aziendale per il programma Horizon 2, con percorsi di chiara proprietà e di escalation

• Servire come principale canale di comunicazione tecnica tra siti, leadership di programma, forum di qualità, regolamentazione e governance

Leadership del team

• Lead a magra, senior Tech Ops focalizzato implementazione e validazione team (diretto e matrice)

• Acro di apprendimento, riutilizzo e miglioramento continuo
descriptionByLocale.en:
Position Purpose

The Enterprise Implementation Lead – Horizon 2 is a senior Technical Operations leadership role accountable for the enterprise-wide technical implementation and validation of the Horizon 2 program. The Horizon 2 program included a patented, yield enhancing manufacturing technology that enables significantly higher immunoglobulin production from the same base amount of plasma. Operating within the Horizon 2 program organization, the role serves as the primary enterprise integrator across Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M), and enabling capital projects, ensuring technical intent, process maturity, validation outcomes, program learnings, and regulatory-facing technical content are coherently translated into effective and sustainable execution at scale.

Role Responsibilities

Horizon 2 Program Technical Accountabilities
The Enterprise Implementation Lead is accountable for the end-to-end technical delivery of the Horizon 2 program across development, process implementation, technology transfer, validation, and the creation of development and technical content required to support global regulatory filings. This includes translating development outputs into scalable, compliant manufacturing solutions and ensuring that process knowledge, control strategies, validation evidence, and regulatory-facing technical narratives are robustly established to enable successful submissions and ongoing deployment as well as new expansion across the CSL network.

• Lead and integrate technical development activities through to process implementation, ensuring continuity of technical intent and readiness for manufacturing scale-up

• Define and execute enterprise process implementation strategies that convert development learnings into site-ready, executable solutions across new and existing facilities

• Own and coordinate Tech Ops accountabilities for technology transfer, including definition of transfer strategies, critical process parameters, and success criteria across sites

• Hold accountability for validation strategy and execution associated with the Horizon 2 program, ensuring validation is risk-based, inspection-ready, and aligned with regulatory expectations

• Own the development and integration of technical and development content required for regulatory submissions, ensuring consistency between development data, validation evidence, and filing narratives

• Ensure alignment between development data, qualification outcomes, validation evidence, and regulatory content to support Manufacturing operational readiness and sustainable GMP production

• Drive Right-First-Time (RFT) delivery through disciplined technical risk management, issue resolution, and data-driven decision-making

Cross-Functional Collaboration, Integration & Governance

• Partner with Manufacturing on Operational Readiness by providing Tech Ops inputs including process knowledge, tech transfer requirements, validation status, and process risk transparency

• Partner with Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) in project delivery to ensure Tech Ops process requirements, parameters, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined and aligned with design, construction, qualification, and asset handover expectations

• Partner closely with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to jointly develop, review, and approve validation strategies, regulatory submission content, and inspection readiness narratives, ensuring alignment between technical execution and regulatory commitments

• Maintain the enterprise-level technical, validation, and regulatory risk register for the Horizon 2 program, with clear ownership and escalation paths

• Serve as the primary technical communication conduit between sites, program leadership, Quality, Regulatory, and governance forums

Team Leadership

• Lead a lean, senior Tech Ops-focused implementation and validation team (direct and matrixed)

• Drive enterprise learning, reuse, and continuous improvement acros
descriptionByLocale.de:
Aufgabenstellung

Die Enterprise Implementation Lead – Horizon 2 ist eine leitende Führungsrolle für die unternehmensweite technische Umsetzung und Validierung des Horizon 2 Programms. Das Horizon 2 Programm beinhaltete eine patentierte, leistungssteigernde Fertigungstechnologie, die eine deutlich höhere Immunglobulinproduktion aus der gleichen Basismenge Plasma ermöglicht. Im Rahmen der Horizon 2 Programmorganisation fungiert die Rolle als primärer Unternehmensintegrator über Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) und ermöglicht Kapitalprojekte, die sicherstellen, dass technische Absichten, Prozessreife, Validierungsergebnisse, Programmerwerbe und regulatorisch ausgerichtete technische Inhalte kohärent in effektive und nachhaltige Ausführung im Maßstab übersetzt werden.

Aufgaben

Horizon 2 Programm Technische Rechenschaften
Die Enterprise Implementation Lead ist verantwortlich für die technische End-to-End-Lieferung des Horizon 2 Programms über Entwicklung, Prozessumsetzung, Technologietransfer, Validierung und die Erstellung von Entwicklungs- und technischen Inhalten, die zur Unterstützung globaler regulatorischer Einreichungen erforderlich sind. Dazu gehören die Übersetzung von Entwicklungsausgängen in skalierbare, konforme Fertigungslösungen und die Sicherstellung, dass Prozesswissen, Steuerungsstrategien, Validierungsnachweise und regulatorisch ausgerichtete technische Erzählungen robust etabliert sind, um erfolgreiche Einreichungen und laufende Bereitstellung sowie neue Erweiterungen im gesamten CSL-Netzwerk zu ermöglichen.

• Führen und integrieren Sie technische Entwicklungsaktivitäten durch die Prozessdurchführung, Sicherstellung der Kontinuität der technischen Absicht und der Bereitschaft zur Herstellung von Scale-up

• Festlegung und Durchführung von Strategien zur Umsetzung von Strategien zur Umsetzung von Entwicklungslern in standortbereite, ausführbare Lösungen in neuen und bestehenden Einrichtungen

• Eigene und koordinierende Rechenschaftspflichten für den Technologietransfer, einschließlich Definition von Transferstrategien, kritischen Prozessparametern und Erfolgskriterien an Standorten

• Halten Sie die Rechenschaftspflicht für Validierungsstrategie und Durchführung im Zusammenhang mit dem Horizon 2 Programm, um sicherzustellen, dass die Validierung risikobasiert, inspiziert und mit regulatorischen Erwartungen ausgerichtet ist

• Eigene Entwicklung und Integration von technischen und entwicklungsbezogenen Inhalten, die für regulatorische Einreichungen erforderlich sind, um die Konsistenz zwischen Entwicklungsdaten, Validierungsnachweisen und Anmelden zu gewährleisten
